title: Senior Practice Leader, Developer Platform for Professional Services, APAC
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Australia, Sydney</strong></p> <p>We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Senior Global Practice Leader for our product portfolio: Developer Platform, Professional services to join our growing team. You will take the lead to build a global practice of practitioners that can realise business outcomes for customers primarily through the capabilities within the Cloudflare developer platform.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a product manager of professional services specifically for our Developer Platform;</li> <li>Prioritizes and executes on building offerings based on alignment with strategic vision.</li> <li>Review information gathered by PS Leaders and other Practice Leaders to understand offering value propositions.</li> <li>Execute on building PS offerings based on direction from Leadership.</li> <li>Builds sales collateral, scoping guidelines, project plans, delivery kits/accelerators.</li> <li>Leads effort to create and maintain selling and delivery enablement.</li> <li>Creates fixed outcome service offerings that are in-line with quick wins.</li> <li>Focuses on a-la-carte add-on services and packaged services targeting different customer profiles, E.g., Mid-Market, Enterprise, Digital Natives, Verticals</li> <li>Demonstrates good communication skills across the PS organization (Delivery Leaders, Services Sales, Consulting Delivery) and Customer Engineering Teams as well as GTM leaders for the Developer Platform product portfolio</li> <li>Own and launch internal and external marketing campaigns (e.g. blog posts, videos, webinars, internal enablement, presentation on worldwide field calls, regional leader calls, etc.) about new or improved offerings.</li> <li>Drive the team's comprehensive understanding of Cloudflare's Developer platform and capabilities, including configuration, optimization, and troubleshooting, ensuring collective expertise within the practice.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Travel:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Limited travel is expected with the only solid  requirement being attendance in person at the 6 monthly PS leadership meetings held in Lisbon and / or Austin. Some customer travel within Australia is also anticipated.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications:</strong><strong><br></strong></p> <ul> <li>Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, or a related field.</li> <li>Minimum of 8 years of experience in professional services, practice architecture or leadership roles, or a developer oriented customer-facing role </li> <li>Strong understanding of the professional services landscape, including both internal and partner-provided services.</li> <li>Strong understanding of development platforms and frameworks and how they can benefit customers. In particular being able to translate business challenges into a developer platform based solution or partial solution.</li> <li>Ability to quickly prototype potential solutions for customers and then provide guidance on the migration from prototype to robust business critical application/solutions should occur.</li> <li>Demonstrable desire to educate fellow professional services staff how to leverage developer platform capabilities within their practice, respectively being Zero Trust Networking and Application services</li> <li>Excellent prior work experience as a Product Manager, Practice Manager or Architect</li> <li>Knowledge and familiarity with the Software Development Life Cycle</li> <li>Demonstrated progressive relevant experience defining, developing, and executing training strategies, operations and action plans</li> <li>Ability to quickly understand technical concepts and explain them to customer and professional services audiences (mostly technical)</li> <li>Proven ability to effectively interact with and influence senior executives and team members</li> <li>Communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.</li> <li>Experienced in giving and receiving constructive feedback</li> <li>Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, unpredictable environment</li> <li>Good understanding of how the Internet works, Networking and Security, Zero Trust Services/SASE, DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP, TLS, APIs and related technologies</li> <li>Experience with Jira and Salesforce (or similar CRM tool) is a plus.</li> <li>Fluency in English (written and oral) is a must. Fluency in one or more additional regional languages is a plus.</li> <li>Hands-on experience implementing and managing content delivery network (CDN), distributed denial-of-service (DDoS) protection, web application firewall (WAF), load balancing, and other related solutions for clients across various industries.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and associated development tools</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

title: Neuroscientist
description: Type: Full-time Location: University of Sussex, Brighton - On-site The Role Netholabs is building AI grounded in biological intelligence. We record petascale, high-resolution neurobehavioural data from living systems and use it to train neural foundation models — a new substrate for the next generation of AI, robotics, and personalised intelligence. We aim to greatly reduce the burden of animals used in basic scientific research and pharmacological work, with eventual removal and replacement by in silico models. We're looking for a Neuroscientist to join our Brighton research team as an independent contributor driving experiments from design through analysis. You'll design and run in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural experiments, work with large-scale neural and behavioural datasets, and partner closely with our ML team to translate what we learn about real brains and bodies into better foundation models. This is a role for someone who wants their science to feed directly into what gets built next. Responsibilities In Vivo Electrophysiology & Neural Recording Design and run in vivo electrophysiology experiments in animal models Develop and refine neural recording protocols and rigs alongside the hardware team Ensure recordings meet the quality and fidelity standards our models are trained on Behavioural Neuroscience & Experimental Design Design behavioural paradigms that generate rich, well-controlled datasets Plan and oversee data collection sessions, in collaboration with technicians Iterate on experimental design based on data quality and downstream modelling needs Data Analysis & Computational Modelling Analyse large-scale neural and behavioural datasets Build and apply computational models to characterise neural and behavioural dynamics Validate findings and communicate results clearly to the broader research team Neuroscience → AI Translation Partner with the ML team to translate biological findings into model design choices Help define what neurobehavioural data and features are most valuable to capture Contribute to internal research direction connecting neuroscience and foundation model development Requirements Core (essential) BSc/MSc in neuroscience, behavioural sciences, or a related field, with hands-on experimental research experience. Preferred: PhD and experience with in vivo electrophysiology and behavioural neuroscience experiments Strong data analysis skills, including experience with Python or a similar language Able to design rigorous experiments and think critically about data quality Excellent communication; comfortable working cross-functionally with engineering and ML teams Valued (or willing to learn) Experience with large-scale or multi-modal neurobehavioural datasets Familiarity with machine learning fundamentals or foundation model training Experience with computational modelling of neural or behavioural data Prior work bridging neuroscience and AI/robotics research Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Systems Engineer - Data Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p>In this role, you’ll help build and maintain Data Security products as a Software Engineer. These products empower customers to gain deep visibility into Cloud/SaaS security opportunities and into trends in their network traffic and product use. As an engineer on the team, you will focus on building new functionality into our APIs and distributed code while ensuring the performance and reliability of our services which ingest millions of data points each day. You’ll be joining a team of bright, knowledge-seeking engineers who are truly missionaries in solving the security and network visibility challenges for our customers.</p> <p><strong>Technologies we use:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Products are written in Go, Python, and Typescript.</li> <li>Code runs on Kubernetes, Cloudflare Workers, AWS, GCP, Azure.</li> <li>We utilize Postgres as our data store, Redis as our cache, and Kafka as our message broker.</li> <li>Our frontend is written in Typescript and React.</li> <li>For service monitoring we use Prometheus and Grafana.</li> <li>For service logging we use Elasticsearch and Kibana.</li> <li>For product analytics we use Clickhouse and BigQuery. </li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience:</strong></p> <ul> <li>3+ years of professional experience building and managing reliable and performant software systems at scale, preferably with technologies like: Go, Python, Postgres</li> <li>Passion for making the digital world a more secure place</li> <li>Excellent debugging and optimization skills</li> <li>Willingness, curiosity, and enthusiasm to learn new programming languages, technologies and systems</li> <li>Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Caring and empathy are coveted traits here!</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus</strong></p> <ul> <li>Frontend programming experience in Typescript/Javascript</li> <li>Previous experience working with third-party API integrations</li> <li>Previous experience working on security products</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. title: Propellant Quality Control Engineer
description: We are looking for a Propellant Quality Control Engineer to ensure the quality, consistency, and traceability of the materials and processes used to manufacture our solid propellants. Working closely with the Lead Propellant Manager, laboratory technicians, propulsion engineers, manufacturing, and suppliers, you will define and execute quality-control activities from incoming raw materials through to finished propellant. This is a hands-on role for someone who combines strong technical judgement with a disciplined approach to measurement, documentation, investigation, and process control. Your work will help ensure that propellant development and production remain safe, repeatable, and aligned with the required performance standards. About us We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Define and perform quality-control checks for raw materials, intermediate products, and finished propellant. Develop and maintain inspection plans, test methods, acceptance criteria, sampling requirements, and quality records. Review laboratory and production data to identify trends, variation, out-of-specification results, and emerging process issues. Lead or support investigations into non-conformances, deviations, material issues, and unexpected test results. Maintain clear traceability of materials, batches, samples, equipment, results, and technical decisions. Work with the Lead Propellant Manager and manufacturing teams to improve process capability, measurement quality, and production consistency. What we are looking for Experience in quality control, quality engineering, laboratory testing, or process control within a chemical, aerospace, manufacturing, or other regulated environment. A degree in chemical engineering, chemistry, materials science, mechanical engineering, or a related discipline. Strong understanding of measurement systems, test methods, sampling, data review, and technical documentation. Experience investigating non-conformances, identifying root causes, and implementing corrective actions. A methodical and detail-oriented approach to safety, traceability, data integrity, and compliance. Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with laboratory, engineering, manufacturing, quality, and supplier teams. Desirable experience Solid rocket propellants, energetic materials, Elastomers, polymers, binders, oxidisers, metallic fuels, or catalysts. Propellant or chemical-material characterisation, including thermal, mechanical, rheological, chemical, or burn-rate testing. Incoming-material inspection, supplier quality, batch release, certificate-of-analysis review, or material qualification. Statistical process control, measurement-system analysis, capability studies, trend analysis, or uncertainty assessment. Experience with hazardous chemicals, explosives, regulated materials, or formal laboratory and manufacturing quality systems. Python, MATLAB, laboratory information systems, electronic records, or other tools for quality and test-data analysis. Benefits and important information: We offer top-decile compensation packages, bonuses and meaningful equity, to attract exceptional aerospace talent. Every employee is awarded stock options in the company, you will directly benefit from your own hard work and success. Comprehensive relocation support including flights, shipping and visas. Lunch, dinner and drinks provided everyday Free access to shared company housing Please note, we are a fast paced, hyper-scaling startup. You will need to be comfortable working extended hours with high levels of autonomy, ownership, and flexibility, with contracts structured around a 48-hour working week. We are committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued, has equal access to opportunity, and can thrive. We welcome different perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences—and believe our differences make us stronger. title: (Senior) DevOps Engineer (m/f/d)

Live Assessment: Showcase your adaptability by solving a practical problem in an unfamiliar context Tech Challenge: A collaborative deep-dive into system architecture, cloud scalability, and handling technical trade-offs. Leadership Conversation: A deep dive into the role and expectations with a member of our technical leadership. On-Site Meeting: Visit our Munich office, meet more of the team, and experience our culture firsthand! What are the benefits of working at Peter Park? We believe in supporting our team with an environment that fosters growth, well-being, and a great work-life balance. Your perks: company pension plan, corporate benefits, and JobRad bike leasing, plus, you can choose between a subsidized Deutschlandticket or an EGYM Wellpass membership. Your fit: a lived start-up mentality in a financially secure and stable environment. Ready to build the future with us? Apply today and let’s make something great together. title: Remote Maintenance Engineer

description: About the role Gauss Fusion is aiming to build the first commercial scale fusion power plant based on the stellarator concept and is seeking an experienced mechanical engineer to lead on development of the robotic maintenance approach. The fusion environment within the reactor is very aggressive, and in-vessel components such as the breeder blanket and divertor will need to be replaced on a regular basis as the materials become damaged by the radiation. Due to the environment inside the device, and in order to maintain a high overall availability, the maintenance must be done robotically using automated systems to extract and replace the components and bring the removed ones to a hot cell for separation, waste treatment, and recycling. Gauss Fusion is looking for an innovative mechanical design engineer with experience in robotics to lead the work defining and developing the maintenance approach for the Gauss stellarator power plant and its key stellarator systems. While the magnetic configuration will be designed to maximise access to the reactor, the complex geometry poses a challenge to fixations and kinematics, and inventive approaches to the problem are required. Main responsibilities Manage the Gauss Fusion maintenance approach to meet the requirements of a commercial scale fusion power plant design: Develop workable approaches to achieving high power plant availability, taking account of engineering and physics requirements across the reactor. Integrate these remote maintenance requirements into plant layout specifications. Define approaches to minimising hot cell inventory through efficient handling of removed components. Lead development of the breeder blanket and divertor segmentation and fixations resulting from these approaches. Lead development of remote maintenance testing and demonstration systems for the reactor. Qualification and educational requirements Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related field, master’s or Ph.D. preferred. Technical experience: Minimum of 6 years of experience in mechanical engineering, preferably in large-scale engineering projects. Experience in designing complex mechanical systems, preferably in the energy or nuclear industry. Familiarity with CAD software and engineering analysis tools. Competences and preferred skills Experience developing remote maintenance systems operating in hazardous environments Strong background in mechatronics, motion control and mechanical integration. Experience with digital mock-up will be an asset Familiarity with maintenance, inspection and intervention systems Familiarity with system engineering processes, requirements management and verification activities. Strong understanding of mechanical design principles and engineering mechanics. Proficiency in structural analysis, finite element analysis (FEA), and kinematic analysis. Ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and coordinate with other engineering disciplines. Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail. Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Full time paid Internship DSU/ Stage DSU Paris
description: Introduction The selected person will join the Technopolis Group Data Science Unit (DSU), whose members work across different country offices. Our growing team brings together diverse academic backgrounds and a shared passion for developing data science applications to improve policymaking. The DSU contributes to policy consulting projects and conducts R&D to develop and test new applications, sometimes in collaboration with internal and external partners. Its work includes record linkage, classification, natural language processing, web scraping, generative AI and dynamic visualisations. As an intern, you will work alongside experienced data scientists and policy consultants, applying and developing your technical skills to address real-world policy questions. About this job The role of the intern in data science for public policy will be to support the data science components of policy evaluations , sectoral studies and strategic consultancy projects. Our clients include French regional councils, the French Development Agency (AFD), ADEME, the European Commission and multilateral development banks. You will be part of the DSU and collaborate with colleagues across policy areas, including science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition, international cooperation and health. You may also contribute to internal R&D and business development activities, particularly the preparation of data science approaches for project proposals. No previous professional experience is required. Relevant coursework, academic research and personal coding projects will be considered. We are looking to recruit a full-time intern for at least 6 months starting in Automn 2026 . Internship should be sponsored by the intern’s university (stage conventionné). Your profile We are looking for a curious and motivated individual who enjoys working with data and wants to understand how data science can inform public policy. Suitable candidates should have: Master’s-level studies in data science, computer science, statistics, economics, engineering or another relevant discipline with a strong quantitative component, and be eligible for a university-sponsored internship. Practical programming skills in Python, demonstrated through coursework, research or personal projects, and the ability to write and understand their own analytical code. Good foundations in statistics and quantitative analysis, together with an interest in economics and public policy and in interpreting analytical results in their policy context. Basic familiarity with machine learning or natural language processing, and an interest in using generative AI and large language models programmatically through APIs for data processing, text analysis and knowledge extraction. A careful and structured approach to working with data, including attention to data quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility. An interest in public policy and in using data science to support evidence-based policymaking , particularly in areas such as science, technology and innovation, economic development, the green transition or health policy. Fluency in French and English, good communication skills and an ability to work collaboratively in an international and multicultural environment. A third language would be an asset. Your responsibilities Working under the guidance of experienced colleagues, you will: Support the design and implementation of data science analyses to answer policy questions, writing code in Python. Collect, clean, link and validate data from multiple sources, including open datasets, databases and web-based sources. Help develop and test analytical workflows, potentially involving machine learning, NLP and LLM APIs for classification, text analysis and knowledge extraction. Contribute to indicators, scoreboards and visualisations, including dashboards where relevant, to make findings accessible to different audiences. Interpret and communicate results, helping prepare reports, methodological documentation and presentations for clients. Contribute to the DSU’s R&D and proposal preparation, for example by exploring new datasets, testing methods or developing small prototypes. Our offer We offer a paid internship in Paris, with hands-on experience at the intersection of data science and public policy. You will work with an international, multidisciplinary team, receive guidance from experienced colleagues and contribute to both client projects and the development of new analytical applications. Many of our interns become full-time staff at Technopolis or go on to pursue opportunities in the public and private sectors. Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Project Manager (m/f/d)
description: Role description As Senior Project Manager, you will join our central Project Management team in Reinbek, which leads the company's large and complex cross-functional projects and sets the standards for how projects are run across all of arethia's global locations. Join us during a pivotal growth phase and help create the foundations of a team that will drive meaningful transformation across the organisation. You will independently lead complex projects with senior stakeholders across departments, and you will be the person we turn to when a project has drifted off course and needs to be brought back on track. This is a delivery role first, and it is also a chance to shape how project management works in a growing, international company: you will contribute to our standards and methods, support colleagues who run their own projects and help build a project management community across our sites. As the team grows, so does the scope of what you can take on. Your Mission Project Leadership – Lead large, cross-functional projects independently from initiation to closure, including planning, governance, steering committees and stakeholder management. Problem Solving - Facilitate and actively participate in problem-solving sessions to drive project success Project Recovery – Take over projects that have drifted off course or lost their lead, diagnose what went wrong and re-establish structure as interim or permanent lead. Stakeholder Management – Navigate demanding situations with senior leadership and across departments and prepare well-founded decisions for steering committees. Quality and Coaching – Support department-led projects as quality assurance and sparring partner and coach project managers on their deliverables. Standards and Methods – Contribute to our project management standards, templates and training formats, and turn project experience into reusable methods. Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Several years of experience independently leading complex, cross-functional projects with full ownership from initiation to closure. Experience working with senior stakeholders and navigating conflicting interests across departments. Strong analytical and problem solving skills. Experience taking over or stabilising projects already in progress. Ability to work independently, propose solutions and make decisions within your remit. Business-level communication skills in German and English (C1). Experience in applying common project management tools, e.g. for task and milestone tracking. Preferred Qualifications Experience with an ERP or comparable large-scale system implementation. IPMA Level C or equivalent. A higher level is a plus. Experience in a manufacturing or regulated production environment. Experience developing project management standards, templates or training formats. Experience with Jira and Confluence. Experience working in an international, multi-site organisation. Why you'll love working here Exciting tasks in an internationally operating, growing family business with flat hierarchies Flexible working hours and a hybrid working model 4 weeks remote work from other EU countries 30 days paid vacation per year Salary bands for a fair corporate culture Monthly allowance of €50 for your BAV Annual 360° feedback loops with clear promotion criteria and an individual career path Responsibility from day one in a company that encourages personal responsibility and growth Relocation costs can be reimbursed on a pro rata basis Regular company events such as summer party, Christmas party Paid team dinners or activities for each team twice a year Free parking right outside the door Perks and benefits: JobRad, subsidized lunch, subsidy for the Deutschlandticket, free language courses and discounted memberships at several gyms and for the Wellpass Fresh fruit, free drinks and snacks in the office Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Majors Account Executive (IBM), New York
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>New York, New Jersey, Connecticut, Massachusetts</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>We are seeking an exceptionally accomplished and visionary Majors Account Executive to join our Enterprise/Field Sales team focused on selling to IBM along with a few other accounts. In this expert-level role, you will be the driving force behind Cloudflare's most strategic customer engagements, leading the charge in securing and expanding critical platform sales within focused accounts. The ideal candidate possesses unparalleled sales leadership, a profound grasp of enterprise architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), and the ability to articulate how Cloudflare seamlessly integrates into modern cloud operating models.</p> <p>As a Majors Account Executive, you will demonstrate the highest level of sales proficiency, ensuring highly accurate forecasting, strategic pipeline management, and consistently exceeding attainment targets. You will be a recognized subject matter expert, providing in-depth education to customers and partners alike on Cloudflare’s extensive product ecosystem and its place within the broader security landscape. This role demands the ability to apply executive sponsorship programs, actively engaging with CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs, and leading virtual teams that include VPs and SVPs to navigate and close complex, transformative opportunities. You will shape our customers' digital transformation journeys, identifying opportunities within broader market trends and positioning Cloudflare as their indispensable strategic partner.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li>Executive-Level Strategic Revenue Leadership: Own and execute the most critical territory and account plans, consistently exceeding multi-million dollar sales targets and annual quotas by architecting and closing large-scale platform sales within highly focused, strategic accounts.</li> <li>Precision Forecasting & Pipeline Mastery: Lead with unparalleled accuracy in forecasting and demonstrate complete mastery of proactive pipeline management. Provide visionary insights and strategic guidance that shapes the direction of the sales organization.</li> <li>Enterprise Architecture & Business Model Expertise: Exhibit an expert-level understanding of customer Enterprise Architecture across all four pillars (business, data, applications, technology), seamlessly mapping these to customer business models. Articulate precisely how Cloudflare fits into and optimizes a modern cloud operating model.</li> <li>C-Suite Engagement & Executive Sponsorship: Lead and orchestrate complex customer engagements across numerous business units simultaneously, connecting the dots to solidify platform sales. Actively apply and manage executive sponsorship programs, ensuring direct engagement and influence with CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs.</li> <li>Cross-Functional Leadership & Influence: Drive and lead highly complex virtual teams that include Product Managers, VPs, and SVPs to manage and close the most strategic customer opportunities. Proactively identify and resolve organizational roadblocks, leveraging company-wide learnings to ensure the most efficient delivery.</li> <li>Digital Transformation Visionary: Serve as Cloudflare's leading voice on digital transformation, engaging deeply with customers on their key drivers for change (e.g., new offering development, customer capabilities). Expertly spot and seize opportunities for Cloudflare within broader market trends that influence these critical decisions.</li> <li>Organizational Communication & Feedback: Connect themes from across departments and global locations to craft critical, crystal-clear messaging. Review performance and output across multiple organizations, providing feedback and solutions to enhance the entire organization’s performance. Deliver challenging news within a constructive learning context.</li> <li>Long-Term Strategic Impact: Consistently articulate how decisions will impact Cloudflare years into the future, willing to trade short-term gains for significant long-term organizational benefit. Build trust by openly sharing learnings and modeling Cloudflare's highest expectations and standards.</li> <li>Define Goals & Drive Efficiency: Play a key role in defining team goals and metrics each quarter, rigorously reviewing results. Deeply understand interdependencies within and across teams, proactively addressing roadblocks to achieve results with maximum efficiency.</li> <li>Company-Wide Innovation & Problem Solving: Consistently and proactively address internal and external needs, driving urgency across the department and company to offer solutions that optimize efficiency. Constructively and humbly challenge the status quo to drive positive change and innovation company-wide, leveraging new insights for continuous iteration.</li> <li>Inclusive Leadership & Future-Proofing: Serve as an exemplary leader, consistently bringing in diverse perspectives to not only address today's needs but also anticipate and solve future problems, contributing significantly to the greater good of Cloudflare.</li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li>10+ years of expert-level experience selling complex, multi-million dollar technology solutions in a B2B enterprise model, with an irrefutable track record of consistently exceeding quota and closing transformative platform deals.</li> <li>Unparalleled in-depth knowledge of Cloudflare's entire product suite and the broader security landscape, coupled with the ability to educate both customers and partners at an expert level.</li> <li>Mastery in understanding Customer Enterprise Architecture (Business, Data, Applications, Technology) and adept at mapping Cloudflare solutions to complex business models and modern cloud operating environments.</li> <li>Proven ability to apply and manage executive sponsorship programs, with extensive experience engaging directly and influencing CIOs, CISOs, and CTOs.</li> <li>Demonstrated success in leading and orchestrating virtual teams comprising VPs and SVPs to manage and close the most strategic customer opportunities.</li> <li>Recognized authority on digital transformation, with a deep understanding of market trends and the ability to strategically position Cloudflare as a critical partner in driving customer innovation.</li> <li>Exceptional strategic communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, capable of delivering impactful messaging to the highest levels of customer and internal leadership.</li> <li>A visionary leader who consistently makes decisions for the long-term benefit of Cloudflare, even if it means trading off short-term gains.</li> <li>Proven ability to define team goals and metrics, drive cross-departmental efficiency, and proactively address roadblocks for optimal results.</li> <li>A humble yet assertive leader who consistently challenges the status quo and drives positive, innovative change across the organization.</li> <li>Expert-level proficiency in advanced sales and business intelligence platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite, MEDDPICC, etc.).</li> <li>Bachelor's degree required, with an MBA or advanced technical degree highly preferred.</li> <li>Ability to travel extensively as required to engage with key customers, executive leadership, and internal teams.</li> </ul> <h2>Compensation</h2> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul> <li>For New York City, New Jersey, Washington, Washington DC, and California (excluding Bay Area) based hires: Estimated annual salary of $330,000- $380,000 (base/variable)</li> </ul> <p>This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.</p> <h3>Equity</h3> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <h3>Benefits</h3> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <h3>Health & Welfare Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <h3>Financial Benefits</h3> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <h3>Time Off</h3> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. title: Accountant
description: About BSQ Accounting At BSQ Accounting, we help the founders of new UK limited companies stay on top of their accounts and compliance from day one. We're the fixed-fee accountancy practice within BSQ Group, working alongside our sister company 1st Formations, one of the UK's leading company formation providers. Our clients join us at the very start of their journey, and we look after their bookkeeping, statutory accounts, tax, VAT and payroll so they can focus on building their business. Running a business shouldn't be slowed down by statutory compliance, accounting or payroll. Together with 1st Formations, we bring formation, compliance, accounting, payroll and ongoing business support into one integrated platform. No stitched-together services. No legacy workflows disguised as software. Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence. Why Join Us Now? You'll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression. £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR Over 1 million companies formed Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business Forecast to grow 5x to 10x over the next three years The Role We're looking for a qualified Accountant to join BSQ Accounting, reporting to our Accounting Manager. Because we serve a large and growing base of newly incorporated limited companies on fixed fees, this is a high-volume role. You'll be one of the team's technical reviewers, checking and signing off compliance work prepared by team members, including our offshore production team, and managing your own workload independently against statutory deadlines. You'll come from an accountancy practice and be comfortable working across a large client base at pace, prioritising by deadline and risk, and keeping a commercial eye on the time spent against a fixed fee. Your expertise will help shape how we deliver accountancy services as we scale, with real scope to progress as the team grows. Key Responsibilities Review and sign off work prepared by team members before submission, including PAYE and VAT registrations, payroll and RTI submissions, VAT returns and CIS returns Review year-end statutory accounts prepared under FRS 105, FRS 102 Section 1A and FRS 102, together with the related corporation tax returns Review Self Assessment tax returns for company directors Prepare more complex or non-standard accounts and returns yourself where needed Manage your own review queue independently, prioritising by statutory deadline and risk across a high volume of clients Give clear, constructive feedback to preparers, helping to raise first-time quality across the team Review bookkeeping and bank reconciliations in Xero, making sure client records are accurate, complete and up to date Handle technical client queries, escalating complex or high-risk matters to the Accounting Manager Spot work that falls outside a client's fixed-fee plan and flag it so it can be scoped and billed Support clients with their Making Tax Digital requirements Help develop internal guidance, review checklists and templates to support consistent, high-quality delivery Identify opportunities to improve processes, tools and client education What We Are Looking For Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or equivalent) with some post-qualification experience Practice background, with solid experience of compliance work for small and owner-managed limited companies Experience of reviewing other people's work, or ready to step up into a reviewing role Strong technical knowledge of FRS 105, FRS 102 Section 1A and FRS 102, with a sound working knowledge of corporation tax, VAT, PAYE, CIS and personal tax as they apply to small businesses Comfortable working with high client volumes, able to prioritise competing deadlines and manage your own workload without close supervision Commercially aware, with an understanding of how a fixed-fee practice works and why efficiency matters Strong hands-on experience with Xero; experience of a practice management system such as Karbon is an advantage A clear communicator, able to explain financial matters to non-specialist business owners and give constructive feedback to colleagues A collaborative mindset, comfortable working within a growing team What We Offer £50,000 to £60,000 and a comprehensive benefits package Hybrid working model Real opportunities for progression as the business scales The chance to influence both customer experience and product development A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning Equal Opportunities BSQ Accounting is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Compensation: £50K – £60K • £50K – £60K Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Owner
description: About 1st Formations At 1st Formations, we empower entrepreneurs to start, run, and grow their businesses with confidence. Running a business shouldn’t be slowed down by company formation, statutory compliance, accounting, or payroll. From day one, these essentials should be seamless, reliable, and intelligently handled — freeing founders to focus on building and scaling. We’re a leading UK provider of company formation and compliance services, building a modern, fully integrated technology platform that supports founders at every stage of their journey. Our platform brings together formation, compliance, accounting, payroll, and ongoing business support in one cohesive experience. No stitched-together services. No legacy workflows disguised as software. Just a single, scalable platform built for ambitious founders who want to move fast, stay compliant, and grow with confidence. Why Join Us Now? You’ll be joining a business with strong momentum, clear direction, and real opportunity for progression. £18m annual revenue, including £9m ARR Over 1 million companies formed Certified B Corp and Carbon Neutral Business Forecast to grow 5x–10x over the next three years The Role As Product Owner (Data & Delivery), you'll own one product area end to end, from requirement through to released, accepted and measured. Working to the Senior Product Manager, you'll turn agreed outcomes into well-shaped requirements, a prioritised backlog and released changes that work for customers, operations and commercial teams. The role is data-led. You'll define the measures that matter for your area, query the data yourself rather than waiting to be told what it shows, and work with our Data and Analytics Lead to turn data needs into clear specifications. Quality is part of the job too: you'll own business acceptance, defect triage and release readiness, with changes you specified accepted by our Product Quality Analyst, and theirs by you. You'll also play a significant part in our platform migration programme, covering requirements, scoping, prototyping and testing. Key Responsibilities Own delivery of your product workstreams end to end, from refined requirement to release and post-release review. Turn outcomes set by the Senior Product Manager or CPO into clear epics, user stories and acceptance criteria. Own and prioritise the backlog, running refinement, planning and review with engineering and design. Manage dependencies and risks, and keep operations, support and commercial teams informed on scope and timing. Define success measures, baselines and targets for each workstream before build starts. Query data directly to size problems, test assumptions and challenge analytical outputs before they're relied on. Analyse funnels, cohorts and drop-off to find where journeys fail and where the commercial opportunity sits. Design and interpret A/B tests, and specify tracking for every change so it's measurable from release. Own reporting for your area, recommending whether to iterate, scale or stop after release. Shape and test platform migration work, including requirements, data mapping, prototyping, reconciliation and dry runs. Own business acceptance, defect triage and release readiness, accepting the Product Quality Analyst's changes and having yours accepted by them. Validate end-to-end customer journeys, including compliance-sensitive steps, and make sure each release has the documentation the business needs. What We Are Looking For 5+ years' experience as a Product Owner, Product Analyst or in Product Operations within a digital product environment, including time owning delivery of a workstream rather than supporting one. Strong hands-on data skills, including writing your own SQL and working confidently with large datasets, so you can answer your own questions and form a view from the data. Sound analytical judgement: you separate signal from noise, recognise when a number isn't reliable, and say so. Experience using funnel, cohort and retention analysis to change what a team builds. Experience designing and interpreting A/B tests, including sample sizing and an honest reading of inconclusive results. Experience defining tracking and event requirements, using tools such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or GA4. Confidence writing clear, testable user stories and acceptance criteria, and running refinement with engineering in an Agile team using tools such as Linear, Jira or Asana. Experience of business or user acceptance testing (BAT/UAT), validating end-to-end customer journeys across web platforms, and holding the line on readiness before release. The ability to take a defined outcome and run it to delivery, making sound trade-offs between value, effort, risk and dependency. Commercial awareness of how product changes affect conversion, revenue, cost to serve and operational load. Clear written and verbal communication across Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, Support and Commercial teams, with the pace and pragmatism to know when good enough is the right answer. A degree in a numerate, business or technology discipline, or equivalent practical experience. Data or platform migration experience (requirements, data mapping, reconciliation and testing) is a strong advantage, and experience in a regulated environment. What We Offer £65-75k and comprehensive benefits package Hybrid working model Real opportunities for progression as the business scales The chance to influence both customer experience and product development A culture that values ownership, impact, and continuous learning Equal Opportunities 1st Formations is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. We consider all applicants for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, criminal history, disability, or gender identity. We encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know. Compensation: £65K – £75K • £65K – £75K Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Terminplaner / Scheduling Engineer (m/w/d)
description: Unser Kunde ist ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen mit rund 1000 Mitarbeitenden. Gebaut werden Übertragungsnetze für die großen Netzbetreiber, Projekte, die über Jahre laufen und bei denen der Endtermin zählt. Aufgaben Sie erstellen und verantworten die Ausführungsterminpläne der Freileitungsprojekte. Sie machen die Terminplanung schon in der Angebotsphase. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>As an Applied AI Engineer on our Enterprise team, your role is to guide some of Germany's largest businesses to the frontier of AI and help them deploy Claude into their operations, their products, and their ways of working. You will become the go-to Claude Platform specialist and trusted technical advisor for your customers, advising their engineering teams on architecture, agent design, and evaluation, and working with the C-level and senior executives who sponsor these programmes to show the business value Claude can create and help them reach a confident decision to build on Claude.</p> <p>Enterprise deals are different. Procurement cycles are longer, more stakeholders are involved, and success depends on being able to connect the technical work to the outcomes the boardroom cares about. You will be as comfortable advising an engineering team on evaluation and architecture as you are presenting a value case to a CIO or CTO, and you will carry the technical thread across every stage of a multi-quarter engagement. Much of this work happens in German, with German executives and engineering teams, so native or fluent German is essential for the role.</p> <p>You will partner closely with Enterprise Account Executives and Applied AI Architects to take each customer from first conversation, through technical evaluation, proof of value and procurement, to the decision to build on Claude. Once they have decided, you set their systems integration partner up to deliver, agreeing the target architecture and what good looks like, and you stay close as the customer's technical advisor on Claude throughout deployment, while the partner does the build. Working alongside Anthropic's Product and Engineering teams, you will use your knowledge of the Claude Platform to advise on evaluation, recommend architectures that meet enterprise security and scale requirements, and create the technical and business resources that help large organisations succeed with Claude.</p> <h2><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Partner with Enterprise Account Executives and Applied AI Architects to take enterprise customers in Germany from first conversation, through technical evaluation, proof of value and procurement, to the decision to build on Claude</li> <li>Lead the technical side of each opportunity through to that decision, and remain the customer's technical advisor on Claude as they deploy</li> <li>Set customers and their systems integration partners up to deliver: agree the target architecture, define what good looks like, and stay on hand to advise the delivery team as the build progresses</li> <li>Guide enterprise customers to the frontier of AI, advising them on how to deploy Claude into their operations, their products, and their ways of working</li> <li>Help customer engineering teams see how they would build on Claude, covering architecture, agent design and evaluation, so they can make a confident decision</li> <li>Build and present the business value case for Claude with C-level and senior executives, in German and English, linking technical capabilities to measurable outcomes such as cost, revenue, risk, and time to market</li> <li>Guide customers through long, multi-stakeholder procurement and adoption cycles, including technical evaluations, proofs of concept, security and architecture reviews, and a clear path to production</li> <li>Work with Account Executives on account strategy, deal qualification, and executive engagement plans, and with Applied AI Architects to keep context and continuity across every engagement</li> <li>Run executive briefings, technical workshops, and enablement sessions for both leadership and engineering audiences</li> <li>Navigate enterprise requirements around security, compliance, data residency, and governance, working with Anthropic's internal teams where needed</li> <li>Identify patterns across enterprise engagements and feed insights back to Product, Engineering, and the wider Applied AI team</li> <li>Travel to customer sites across Germany for executive meetings, workshops, and relationship building</li> </ul> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Native or fluent German, written and spoken, as you will work day to day with German enterprise customers at both executive and engineering level</li> <li>6+ years of experience as a Software Engineer, Solutions Architect, Forward Deployed Engineer, or technical founder</li> <li>Experience in a pre-sales or technical advisory role selling into large enterprises, ideally in the German market, including scoping and designing complex solutions</li> <li>Experience with value-based selling, meaning you can build a business case, quantify impact, and present it to senior decision makers</li> <li>Comfort presenting to, and building relationships with, C-level and VP-level stakeholders</li> <li>Experience owning the technical win in enterprise deals: evaluations, proofs of concept and technical due diligence with engineering, security, legal and procurement teams</li> <li>Production experience with LLM-powered applications, including prompting, context engineering, agent architectures, evaluation frameworks, and deployment at scale</li> <li>A hands-on engineering background, including building and deploying production applications, so you can relate to engineering leaders and their teams</li> <li>Familiarity with enterprise security, compliance, and architecture requirements, and experience working through them with customer teams</li> <li>The ability to explain complex AI concepts clearly to both technical and executive audiences, and to move between industries such as financial services, healthcare, retail, and manufacturing</li> <li>A passion for making powerful technology safe and beneficial</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study: </strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong> We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit <u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u> directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong> Learn about <a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><h2><strong>About the Role</strong></h2> <p>We’re building a new Feature Engineering Platform that will be the front door to ML development at global scale. As a Software Engineer on this team, you’ll help build a seamless experience for ML practitioners across the company — from experimentation and exploration to deployment and monitoring.</p> <p>Our mission is to make machine learning accessible and intuitive without compromising on power or performance. You’ll work on a layered platform that supports both high-level declarative workflows and lower-level imperative APIs, all integrated into the environments our users already work in (like notebooks and internal sandboxes).</p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Build and evolve APIs, SDKs, and platform integrations that power feature engineering workflows.</li> <li>Help shape user-facing tools to make the platform approachable for all skill levels.</li> <li>Collaborate across the ML lifecycle — from data ingestion to feature serving — and integrate tightly with our central Data Control Plane.</li> <li>Contribute to platform reliability, testing, observability, and operational excellence.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Qualifications</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Solid engineering background, ideally in platform, data, or ML-adjacent teams.</li> <li>Comfortable working with backend systems, APIs, and ideally some exposure to distributed compute (e.g. Spark, Flink).</li> <li>Empathy for users and interest in building abstractions that remove friction.</li> <li>Curious and collaborative mindset — eager to learn from others and contribute broadly.</li> <li>Experience with ML tooling, or data pipelines is a plus.</li> </ul> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. When you join this team, you will be driving action from the frontlines, rather than just doing yet another analytics role.</p> <p>Your job will mainly focus on driving operational efficiency with the <strong>Workforce Management (WFM) </strong>team and optimizing resource allocation by creating accurate scheduling and intraday forecasts, simplifying forecasting processes, building and supporting KPI dashboards, conducting root cause analysis for SLA improvements, exploring cost optimization opportunities, managing the capacity plan framework, enhancing the WFM data pipeline, and uncovering data-driven insights to refine planning, scheduling, reporting, and intraday management.</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <p>Required:</p> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of experience</strong> in a data science or analytics position</li> <li>Experience building<strong> forecasting models and time series analysis</strong> (Prophet, SARIMA, Holt-Winters or similar)</li> <li>Experience in<strong> Cost Analysis and What-if Scenario Analysis</strong></li> <li>Deep knowledge of statistical packages in <strong>Python or R</strong></li> <li>Proficiency in writing structured and efficient<strong> SQL queries</strong> for large data sets</li> <li>Ability to<strong> influence and advise senior stakeholders </strong>Good to have:</li> <li>Experience using ML for forecasting</li> <li>Experience working with ML engineers/ML platform</li> <li>Building data pipelines using Airflow or similar tools</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <ul> <li>The online delivery platform that Wolt is building will offer you interesting and complex challenges, together with the opportunities to create a big impact with your skills. Lots of geolocational and temporal data in real-time, combined with differences in the economics and dynamics of the cities we operate in, make Wolt both a challenging and interesting company to practice analytics.</li> <li>You have the chance to decide the ways of working: a hybrid, at the office, or remote in <strong>Berlin. </strong>💙 </li> <li>You would get to work in a company culture where we take ownership beyond the obvious, do common things uncommonly well, we think big but stay humble, do right by people, we treat others kindly and justly, recognize that if we don’t learn, we won’t stay still but fall behind and keep in mind that Luke was Yoda’s greatest achievement.</li> </ul> <h2>Next steps</h2> <p>The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!</p> <p>For any further questions about the position, you can turn to Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Zhanna Filintseva via <a ---------- <p> </p> <p><iframe src="https://www.youtube.com/embed/Ncz4s_oBczc?si=FzuwoSOLcv5WZVRN" width="560" height="314"></iframe></p><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">We’re committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. description: <div class="content-intro"><p>Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital.
