Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.</p> <p>You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.</p></div><p>This is a remote opportunity and we are looking for candidates from the UK, Sweden, Spain or Germany.</p> <h3><strong>About the role:</strong></h3> <p>We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer - SRE to help us support our highest value Grafana Cloud customers by increasing the reliability of our Cloud databases that are based on Mimir, Loki, Tempo, and Pyroscope. We provide these databases as a SaaS product from AWS, GCP, and Azure across all regions.</p> <p>The SRE team is embedded within the Mimir, Loki, and Tempo squads and focuses on ensuring that Grafana Cloud’s database products deliver exceptional reliability for our highest-SLA customers. In this role, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Partner closely with product engineering squads (embedded model)</li> <li>Own production reliability for high-SLA and complex customer environments</li> <li>Design and implement automation to scale our reliability practices</li> <li>Ensuring our customers meet our SLO targets</li> <li>Define and evolve per-tenant SLOs and reliability models</li> <li>Proactively reduce SLO burn to prevent repeat incidents</li> <li>Serving as a primary escalation point and on-call for relevant incidents</li> <li>Lead customer-impacting incident response and post-incident reviews</li> <li>Contribute to design docs and code reviews</li> <li>Influence feature design to ensure production scalability and operability</li> <li>Build automation to eliminate toil where needed</li> <li>Improve alert quality and reduce noisy escalations</li> </ul> <p>We seek a staff software engineer operating at the intersection of customer needs, production systems, and product engineering.</p> <p>We invest heavily in developer productivity. You can use modern AI coding assistants as part of your daily workflow (your choice of tools, within security guidelines), backed by a company-funded usage budget so you can iterate quickly without unnecessary friction. We encourage pragmatic AI-assisted development: faster prototyping, test generation, refactors, documentation, and incident follow-ups—always paired with strong code review and quality standards. You'll also have access to the latest frontier models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google.</p> <h3><strong>What we seek:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>8+ years engineering experience, 4+ in SRE/CRE/production engineering. Strong preference for those with formal customer reliability engineering experience.</li> <li>Strong Kubernetes experience in AWS, GCP, or Azure, and familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tooling (Helm, Terraform, Jsonnet, etc.).</li> <li>Strong experience with technical leadership, leading a team through projects, mentoring other engineers on the team and serving as a force-multiplier</li> <li>Experience operating multi-tenant systems in production</li> <li>Strong experience designing and implementing SLOs</li> <li>Experience with one or more programming languages (e.g. Go, Python, Java, etc)</li> <li>Experience with Linux operating systems internals, and some knowledge of networking, cloud storage, and scaling.</li> <li>Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.</li> <li>Experience with calmly and actively participating in blame-free Incident Response, following up on actions, and writing high quality PIRs (Post Incident Reviews, a.k.a. post-mortem documents)</li> <li>Ability to reason about performance, scaling, and failure modes</li> <li>Comfortable working within an engineering team where individuals are encouraged to have a strong sense of autonomy and self-direction.</li> <li>Ability to partner deeply with product engineering teams</li> <li>We highly value those who are intellectually curious, who default to transparency, possess a high bias towards action, and who are also kind (this is important!)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Your day-to-day will include:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Regular 1:1s to with your manager and colleagues</li> <li>Reviewing and creating SLOs, proactively investigating ways in which we can further reduce budget burn for those SLOs, which can be self-directed or as the result of learnings from incidents, and may include improvements to monitoring, automation, increasing self-healing, auto-scaling, etc.</li> <li>Improve observability of customers within their environments</li> <li>Designing and implementing solutions to ensure reliability and scalability of our environments can meet rapidly increasing demands</li> <li>Develop fault-tolerant design patterns ensuring that we are considering reliability at all stages of the service lifecycle.</li> <li>Collaborating with our Engineering Leaders to help define and influence product strategy, roadmaps and technical designs</li> <li>Participate in PR review and collaborating with other engineers on their Design Docs</li> <li>Teach others about Site Reliability Engineering and communicate best practices to be applied early in development of new features and functionality</li> <li>Participate in Incident Response when applicable, including investigation through to resolution, PIR, and communication with customers via Bridge calls where necessary</li> </ul> <p>In Germany, the Base compensation range for this role is €109,709 - €131,651.  Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed <a class="c-link" href="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://grafana.com/about/careers/#jobs" data-sk="tooltip_parent">here</a>.<span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Remote</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(236, 240, 241);">#LI-Remote</span></p><div class="content-conclusion"><div> <p><em data-stringify-type="italic">*Compensation ranges are country specific. title: R&D Intern - Fairness in Deep Learning - Paris
description: <p><strong>Contexte :</strong></p> <p>Offre de stage de recherche de master d’une durée de 4 à 6 mois, débutant en hiver 2026-2027. Ce document liste les possibles directions pour le stage, qui seront ajustées au fil du stage. Le stage aura lieu au sein du centre de recherche d’Artefact à Paris.</p> <p>L’objectif est d'étudier les réseaux de neurones dans un cadre où l’on souhaite garantir l'indépendance des prédictions vis-à-vis d'une variable sensible continue (telle que l'âge, le revenu, la couleur de peau, etc.).</p> <p><strong>Présentation d’Artefact :</strong></p> <p>Artefact est une société internationale de services autour de la data, spécialisée dans le conseil en transformation data, dont la mission est de transformer la donnée  en délivrant des résultats tangibles sur l’ensemble de la chaîne de valeur des entreprises. L’approche unique d’Artefact, qui fait le pont entre la donnée et le business, permet à nos clients d’atteindre leurs objectifs business de façon dédiée et efficace. Nos 2500 employés allient leurs compétences pluridisciplinaires au profit  de l’innovation business des entreprises. Nos technologies de pointe en Intelligence Artificielle, nos méthodes agiles garantissent le succès des projets IA de nos clients, de la conception au déploiement, jusqu’à la formation et l’accompagnement au changement.</p> <p><strong>Sujet :</strong></p> <p>Les réseaux de neurones sont aujourd'hui au cœur de nombreuses applications industrielles. Leur capacité à extraire des représentations riches à partir des données en fait des outils de choix, mais elle les rend aussi susceptibles d'encoder et d'amplifier des biais présents dans les données d'apprentissage, renforçant ainsi des discriminations chez les populations traitées par ces modèles [1]. Cet enjeu est un domaine de recherche dénommé fairness, et est particulièrement dynamique, avec la réglementation des modèles d’IA qui évolue, comme par exemple avec l’AI Act de l’Union Européenne.</p> <p><br>Pour mesurer et mitiger les biais discriminatoires dans les modèles, la littérature s'est majoritairement concentrée sur des variables sensibles binaires ou catégorielles (genre, origine ethnique, etc.), pour lesquelles les groupes sont bien définis [2-5]. Cependant de nombreuses variables sensibles sont intrinsèquement continues : l'âge, le revenu, ou encore la couleur de peau. Discrétiser ces variables en groupes est une pratique courante mais problématique : le choix des seuils est arbitraire, de l'information est perdue, et un modèle peut sembler équitable pour un découpage donné tout en restant fortement biaisé pour un autre [6]. Contrôler la dépendance entre les sorties d'un modèle et une variable continue reste un problème ouvert, notamment pour les réseaux de neurones, où il faut à la fois mesurer cette dépendance et la pénaliser de façon différentiable au cours de l'apprentissage.</p> <p><br>Durant ce stage, le/la stagiaire explorera les méthodes de réduction des biais par rapport à une variable sensible continue pour des réseaux de neurones. Le travail commencera par l'implémentation des méthodes existantes (régularisations basées sur des mesures de dépendance telles que la corrélation maximale de Hirschfeld-Gebelein-Rényi ou “Generalized Disparate Impacte”, etc.), listées dans les références [7-8], et par la mise en place d'un protocole robuste pour les comparer, en tenant compte du compromis entre performance et fairness. Dans un second temps, le stage se concentrera sur la conception et l'expérimentation de nouvelles méthodes de réduction de biais adaptées aux variables continues. Pour cela, le/la stagiaire pourra s'appuyer sur des bibliothèques open source (PyTorch, scikit-learn), afin de rester dans un cadre de code reproductible et facile à adopter.</p> <p><strong>Pré-requis</strong></p> <p>Le profil recherché pour ce poste est le suivant :<br>BAC+4/BAC+5 : Formation en mathématiques appliquées, statistiques ou machine learning au sein d’une université ou école d’ingénieur<br>Stage de césure ou stage de fin d’études<br>Date de début : Hiver 2026-2027<br>Durée : 4 à 6 mois</p> <p><strong>Références</strong></p> <ol> <li>Risser, L., Sanz, A. G., Vincenot, Q., & Loubes, J. M. (2022). Tackling algorithmic bias in neural-network classifiers using wasserstein-2 regularization. <em>Journal of Mathematical Imaging and Vision</em>, <em>64</em>(6), 672-689.</li> <li>Buolamwini, J., & Gebru, T. (2018, January). Gender shades: Intersectional accuracy disparities in commercial gender classification. In <em>Conference on fairness, accountability and transparency</em> (pp. 77-91). PMLR.</li> <li>Cho, J., Zala, A., & Bansal, M. (2023, October). Dall-eval: Probing the reasoning skills and social biases of text-to-image generation models. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 3020-3031). IEEE.</li> <li>Li, X., Chen, Z., Zhang, J. M., Sarro, F., Zhang, Y., & Liu, X. (2023). Dark-skin individuals are at more risk on the street: Unmasking fairness issues of autonomous driving systems. <em>CoRR abs/2308.02935</em>.</li> <li>Thong, W., Joniak, P., & Xiang, A. (2023, October). Beyond skin tone: A multidimensional measure of apparent skin color. In <em>2023 IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision (ICCV)</em> (pp. 4880-4890). IEEE.</li> <li>Shilova, V., Malherbe, E., Palma, G., Risser, L., & Loubes, J. M. (2025). Fairness-aware grouping for continuous sensitive variables: Application for debiasing face analysis with respect to skin tone. In <em>ECAI 2025: 28th European Conference on Artificial Intelligence 25-30 October 2025, Bologna, Italy-Including 14th Conference on Prestigious Applications of Intelligent Systems (PAIS 2025) Proceedings</em> (pp. 5344-5351).</li> <li>Mary, J., Calauzenes, C., & El Karoui, N. title: Développeur Nouveaux Projets (F/H/X)
description: Localisation Poste basé à Lyon ou Dijon. Vous êtes passionné(e) par le développement des énergies renouvelables et vous connaissez bien le tissu économique et territorial de l’Est de la France ? Rejoignez Novar et devenez un acteur clé de la transition énergétique ! En tant que Développeur Nouveaux Projets , vous serez en première ligne pour identifier et sécuriser de nouveaux sites solaires et/ou de stockage en régions AURA et Bourgogne, tout en construisant des relations solides avec les acteurs locaux (collectivités, propriétaires fonciers, entreprises, partenaires). Grâce à votre sens du terrain et votre capacité à fédérer, vous participerez activement au développement de projets qui font sens pour le territoire et ses habitants. Vos missions · Assurer une veille active des opportunités de marché (appels à projets, appels d’offres) sur votre territoire. · Construire et maintenir un réseau local solide, incluant partenaires, collectivités et apporteurs d’affaires. · Identifier de nouveaux sites à potentiel grâce à votre réseau, aux outils cartographiques et à vos actions de terrain. · Réaliser l’analyse technico-économique des sites, en intégrant contraintes et risques. · Approcher les propriétaires fonciers, agriculteurs, collectivités et clients C&I afin de présenter Novar et ses solutions. · Préparer et présenter des réponses à des appels à projets. · Négocier et contractualiser les accords fonciers et commerciaux. · Assurer le suivi des opportunités jusqu’à leur concrétisation et leur passage en phase de développement. · Contribuer à l’amélioration continue des outils, process et connaissances internes liés au développement territorial. Votre profil · Formation Bac+5 : école de commerce, master en aménagement du territoire, urbanisme ou droit rural. · Expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans un rôle similaire (prospection foncière, développement ENR ou aménagement territorial). · Excellentes capacités relationnelles et de négociation. · Goût prononcé pour le terrain et le contact direct avec les acteurs locaux. · Esprit d’analyse, rigueur et autonomie dans la gestion de projets. · Motivation à évoluer dans un secteur porteur et en pleine transformation. Ce que NOVAR vous offre Chez Novar, nous ne vous proposons pas seulement un emploi – nous vous invitons à rejoindre une véritable aventure. Vous travaillerez dans un environnement entrepreneurial et innovant, où l’énergie est au cœur de tout – au sens propre comme au sens figuré. Aux côtés de professionnels passionnés, vous contribuerez concrètement à la mise en œuvre de systèmes énergétiques durables. Et qu’est-ce que cela vous apporte ? 💰 Un salaire attractif, compris entre 48 060 € et 62 383 €, en fonction de votre expérience et de votre parcours. 🎁 Un système de primes basé sur la performance. 🌴 Une prime vacances. 🩺 Mutuelle famille financée à 50% 🚗 Une voiture de fonction. 🏠 Un mode de travail flexible et hybride – dans nos bureaux modernes ou confortablement depuis chez vous. 📚 Des opportunités de développement professionnel dans le domaine du stockage d’énergie par batteries (BESS). 🏆 Un voyage collectif annuel avec l’ensemble du groupe Novar, une expérience inoubliable – travailler dur et célébrer ensemble. À propos de Novar – Nous façonnons l’avenir énergétique de l’Europe Chez Novar, nous croyons que l’avenir de l’énergie est vert – et nous le concrétisons. Depuis notre création en 2014 aux Pays-Bas, nous sommes devenus un acteur majeur du développement et de l’exploitation de grandes installations d’énergies renouvelables. Avec plus de 150 collaborateurs engagés et 800 MWc de capacité installée, nous faisons avancer la transition énergétique à pleine vitesse. Ce qui a commencé par des centrales solaires au sol est devenu une entreprise énergétique complète. Aujourd’hui, nous développons et fournissons de l’énergie solaire, du stockage par batteries, du solaire thermique, de l’hydrogène, des réseaux intelligents et bien plus encore. Nous couvrons toute la chaîne de valeur – du développement et de la construction à la gestion de l’énergie et à l’innovation. Depuis 2024 nous étendons nos activités au-delà de notre marché d’origine, avec une présence en Suède, en Allemagne et en France. title: Technicien Maintenance & Métrologie
description: A propos du poste : Rejoignez Excelya, où Audace, Bienveillance et Énergie sont au cœur de notre façon de travailler. Nous favorisons un environnement collaboratif dans lequel chacun peut développer son expertise et contribuer à des projets à forte valeur ajoutée dans le secteur des Life Sciences. Dans le cadre d’une mission au sein d’un environnement industriel pharmaceutique et dermo-cosmétique , nous recherchons un(e) Technicien(ne) Métrologie & Conformité. Intégré(e) au service Utilités & Métrologie , vous contribuez au suivi et à la fiabilité du parc d’appareillage scientifique du site. Votre rôle est de garantir la conformité, la fiabilité et la sécurité des équipements , tout en assurant le suivi des interventions de métrologie et de maintenance. Missions Principales : Assurer la gestion, le suivi et la mise à jour du parc d’équipements et d’appareils de mesure ; Planifier et réaliser les contrôles et vérifications métrologiques périodiques des équipements ; Participer au suivi et à la vérification des installations liées au traitement d’air, CVC et HVAC ; Réaliser ou coordonner les opérations de maintenance et de métrologie, en collaboration avec les utilisateurs et les prestataires externes ; Analyser les pannes, dysfonctionnements et non-conformités, assurer leur suivi et contribuer à la mise en œuvre des actions correctives ; Analyser les rapports de contrôle et vérifier la conformité des prestations réalisées ; Réaliser des essais techniques et comparatifs afin de développer ou d’améliorer les méthodes de contrôle métrologique ; Rédiger, mettre à jour et déployer les procédures métrologiques et organisationnelles ; Assurer la traçabilité des interventions ainsi que la mise à jour des informations relatives aux équipements dans les outils de gestion dédiés ; Collaborer avec les différents services afin d’analyser les prestations réalisées, d’identifier les nouveaux besoins et de garantir le maintien en conformité du parc Requirements À propos de vous Chez Excelya, nous encourageons chacun à faire preuve d'audace et à développer son potentiel. Nous recherchons des professionnels partageant nos valeurs et souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement stimulant. Expérience : Vous disposez d’au moins 3 ans d’expérience sur des activités de métrologie, maintenance, instrumentation ou suivi d’équipements, idéalement dans un environnement industriel réglementé. Compétences techniques : Vous maîtrisez les activités de métrologie et de vérification périodique, ainsi que le suivi d’un parc d’équipements. Des connaissances en traitement d’air / CVC / HVAC, maintenance et analyse de pannes sont appréciées. Qualité et conformité : Vous êtes à l’aise avec l’identification et le traitement des non-conformités, l’analyse de rapports de contrôle et la gestion documentaire associée. Outils : Vous maîtrisez les outils bureautiques, notamment Excel. La connaissance d’un logiciel de gestion de la métrologie, notamment Optimu, constitue un plus. Référentiels : La connaissance des normes ISO 9001 et ISO 10012, ainsi que des exigences réglementaires liées à la métrologie, est appréciée. Formation : Vous êtes issu(e) d’une formation technique Bac+2 à Bac+3 en métrologie, mesures physiques, instrumentation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine équivalent. Qualités personnelles : Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour votre rigueur, votre autonomie et votre sens de l’organisation. Votre esprit d’analyse, vos qualités relationnelles et rédactionnelles et votre capacité à travailler avec différents interlocuteurs seront essentiels pour réussir dans cette mission. Permis B requis. Benefits Pourquoi nous rejoindre ? Chez Excelya, nous associons passion pour la science et esprit d'équipe afin de redéfinir l'excellence dans le secteur de la santé. Ce qui nous distingue : Nous sommes une entreprise de santé ambitieuse réunissant plus de 900 collaborateurs à travers l'Europe, avec l'objectif de devenir le leader européen des CRO de taille intermédiaire tout en offrant la meilleure expérience collaborateur . Notre modèle de services intégré, combinant conseil, Functional Service Provider et Full Service, vous permettra d'évoluer sur des projets variés et à forte valeur ajoutée. Vous travaillerez aux côtés d'experts reconnus et contribuerez concrètement à l'amélioration du parcours patient. Exceller avec bienveillance Chez Excelya, la bienveillance est au cœur de nos actions. Nous favorisons l'égalité des chances et construisons un environnement de travail diversifié, équitable et inclusif, où chacun peut s'épanouir, être reconnu et contribuer pleinement à une mission commune. Vos défis deviennent notre mission collective. Ensemble, nous transformons les idées ambitieuses en réalisations concrètes, à la manière d'Excelya. Rejoignez-nous aujourd’hui et devenez un Excelyate ! Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

title: Workforce Planning Analyst (Maternity Cover)
description: About Motorway Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding. This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better. About the Role This is an exciting opportunity to become an integral part of Motorways Workforce Planning Team. As the critical link, you will directly support Contact Centre teams across Motorway in achieving their Service Delivery Plans. Your analysis and utilisation of resources are essential to meeting critical Service Level Agreements, while simultaneously increasing overall productivity and efficiency. You’ll proactively drive value through effective planning and detailed analysis of performance, including communicating current and future performance outlooks to stakeholders. You will create and distribute agent schedules based on demand forecasts and operational targets, ensuring optimal resource allocation across all contact channels (Voice, Live Chat, Email, and Tickets). Key components of this role include tracking real time and historical operational performance and adherence to plans, utilising tools such as Calabrio, Zendesk Contact Centre/Amazon Connect, and Google Sheets. You'll provide deep analysis and insights into KPI performance and productivity metrics to identify critical trends and highlight performance risks. A deep understanding and application of end to end workforce planning methodologies, processes and systems, is essential for success in this fast paced contact center environment. What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities) Develop accurate demand forecasts and capacity plans across all channels (Voice, Live Chat, Email, and Tickets). Create, adjust, and distribute daily and weekly agent schedules, utilizing WFM principles to optimise resource allocation and utilization. Actively track and monitor the real time performance of KPIs and adherence to plans. Implement dynamic intraday adjustments to staffing and skill routing to mitigate performance risks. Provide deep analysis and data driven insights into operational performance (i.e. utilisation, occupancy, productivity). Proactively update and engage with operational stakeholders on current and future performance outlooks, translating complex WFM data into actionable business language. Maintain, build, and enhance operational reports to support data driven decision making. What You'll Bring (Required Skills and Experience) Demonstrated success and hands on experience in end to end workforce planning and real time monitoring. Strong working knowledge of WFM systems (e.g. Calabrio, Genesys, NICE or similar) and contact center omnichannel platforms. Exceptional skill in using analytical tools (such as Google Sheets/Excel) to manipulate large data sets and translate complex data for stakeholders. Excellent ability to manage multiple, conflicting priorities effectively, particularly urgent real time needs. A proactive, self motivated approach to identifying operational gaps and implementing solutions independently. Experience working in a fast paced omnichannel contact centre environment. Our interview process Intro Call with Talent Partner - 30 minutes Hiring Manager Interview - 60 minutes Final Interview and Take Home Assessment - 60 minutes You can expect to hear back from us within a week of each interview stage. title: Infrastructure Engineer
description: Infrastructure Engineer Hybrid/Tunbridge Wells | Unlimited Holiday | Keeping customer infrastructure secure, resilient and ready for what comes next. Infinity Group are a innovative Microsoft Cloud Solution Partner based in the UK. We excel in providing award-winning IT Support, Digital Transformation, and Microsoft Dynamics 365 Consultancy services. With a robust team of over 180 professionals, we operate from offices in Tunbridge Wells and London Paddington. Our exceptional work has earned us the prestigious title of Microsoft Partner of the Year for Dynamics Business Central. We are dedicated to fostering a more productive and secure work environment for organizations utilizing Dynamics 365, Microsoft 365, and Azure. Guided by core values of empathy, creativity, ambition, authenticity, and confidence, we celebrate diversity and strive to create a supportive and innovative work environment. We are committed to the well-being and growth of our employees, and we prioritize continuous learning and development through fully funded training programs. Our focus on people, expertise, and commitment to excellence underscores our mission to make a positive impact in the tech industry. Role Overview: Our customers rely on their infrastructure to operate securely and without disruption. This role exists to protect that foundation. You’ll take ownership of the health, performance and security of customer environments across Microsoft Azure and on-premises infrastructure. You’ll prevent avoidable issues, resolve complex problems and ensure new solutions move smoothly into live service. Working across Service Desk, Cyber Security and project delivery, you’ll help turn infrastructure support from a reactive service into a proactive source of customer confidence and long-term value What you'll be doing: Infrastructure health and performance Own the day-to-day health of customer infrastructure across Azure and on-premises environments. Monitor availability, performance and capacity, taking action before emerging issues affect the customer. Secure and controlled operations Maintain secure configurations, access controls and patching standards across supported platforms. Ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within agreed timescales and that operational activity supports Cyber Essentials and ISO 27001 expectations. Incident resolution and prevention Act as an escalation point for complex infrastructure incidents. Diagnose issues across servers, storage, virtualisation, networking and cloud services, then turn root-cause findings into preventative improvements. Platform maintenance and recovery Plan and deliver patches, upgrades and maintenance activity with the right change control, testing and rollback planning. Maintain backup, restore and disaster-recovery readiness across customer environments. Customer and service improvement Identify practical ways to make customer environments more stable, secure and efficient. Provide clear recommendations that improve service quality and create opportunities for wider optimisation or modernisation. Cross-team delivery Work closely with Service Desk, Cyber Security and project teams to ensure infrastructure changes are supportable from day one. Create useful runbooks, accurate records and effective knowledge transfer rather than documentation for its own sake. The kind of problems you’ll solve A customer’s infrastructure is slowing down, but the cause could sit across compute, storage, networking or cloud services. An Azure or Windows Server environment has grown without enough control, creating performance, cost or security risks. Critical patches must be deployed without disrupting customer operations. Backup jobs appear successful, but recovery readiness has not been properly validated. An Azure Virtual Desktop environment is creating inconsistent performance or user disruption. Storage capacity is approaching its limit, with no clear plan for optimisation or expansion. A recurring incident has been repeatedly fixed but never properly prevented. A newly delivered solution is technically complete but not yet ready to be supported effectively. What sets you apart You look beyond the immediate fault and ask what allowed it to happen. You take ownership through to resolution rather than simply passing problems between teams. You can move between Azure and on-premises environments without treating them as separate worlds. You balance technical quality with customer disruption, commercial reality and operational risk. You communicate technical issues clearly, without unnecessary complexity or ambiguity. You are disciplined around patching, change control, documentation and recovery planning. You are comfortable managing competing priorities across multiple customer environments. You bring credible experience of Windows Server, Azure infrastructure, identity, networking, virtualisation, storage and backup technologies. Azure hybrid certification, particularly AZ-800 and AZ-801, provides a strong foundation for the role. Your impact: On the business: You reduce avoidable incidents, repeated support effort and operational risk. By improving infrastructure standards and identifying opportunities for optimisation, you also help strengthen customer retention and support future cloud and transformation work. On customers: Customers gain infrastructure they can rely on: secure, well-maintained and capable of supporting their day-to-day operations. When issues do happen, they receive clear communication, confident ownership and lasting resolution. On team performance: Service Desk receives stronger escalation support, project teams achieve cleaner handovers and Cyber Security gains better operational alignment. The result is a more consistent service, clearer accountability and less time spent solving the same problems repeatedly. What it's like here: Ambitious, but not political High standards, but pragmatic People who care about doing things properly — not just hitting numbers You’ll get: Real ownership of how sales evolves Freedom to change things that don’t work A team open to being challenged and developed Direct access to leadership and influence over direction What you get: Unlimited annual leave Private healthcare, life assurance, company shares Electric car scheme Flexible / remote working (with access to Tunbridge Wells & Paddington) Team and company socials, including Illuminate Awards Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)
description: <h2><strong>Product Design Director - Patient (x/f/m)</strong></h2> <h2><strong>The opportunity</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib is a mission-driven healthcare technology company, founded in Paris in 2013. Today, nearly <strong>3,000 people</strong> work across Europe to transform the way healthcare is delivered and experienced.</p> <p>More than <strong>500,000 healthcare professionals</strong> use Doctolib’s solutions, and the patient app is used by approximately <strong>90 million people</strong> across Europe.</p> <p>For patients, Doctolib began as a simple way to find a healthcare professional and book an appointment. We are now building something much more ambitious: an <strong>AI-powered Health Companion</strong> that helps people navigate care, understand their health and take the right next step throughout their health journey.</p> <p>This means moving beyond a primarily transactional product towards an experience that supports patients before, during and after care, through access to care, health information, patient data, messaging, recommendations, care plans and AI-powered assistance.</p> <p>We are looking for a Product Design Director to help define what this next generation of patient experience should look and feel like.</p> <h2><strong>What you will build and lead</strong></h2> <p>As <strong>Product Design Director, Patient</strong>, you will own the design vision and quality bar for Doctolib’s patient experience. You will report to our VP Design and work closely with the Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business leadership teams. </p> <p>Your scope will cover the full patient journey, including:</p> <ul> <li>access to care, search and booking;</li> <li>patient messaging and teleconsultation;</li> <li>the Patient Health Record and patient context;</li> <li>the app homepage and daily health experience;</li> <li>health content and prevention;</li> <li>recommendations, reminders and care plans;</li> <li>new patient services and subscription experiences;</li> <li>conversational and AI-powered experiences.</li> </ul> <p>The current team includes <strong>six Senior Product Designers and one Senior Content Designer</strong>. You will lead, coach and develop this team while shaping the organisation and operating model needed to support the next phase of the Patient product.</p> <h2><strong>Your mandate</strong></h2> <p>You will:</p> <ul> <li>Define and drive the design vision for the Patient stream, from a high-traffic booking experience to a trusted Health Companion used throughout the health journey.</li> <li>Bridge two equally important challenges: continuing to improve the core access-to-care experience while creating new reasons for patients to return beyond booking.</li> <li>Raise the quality bar for product design, interaction design and content across the patient experience.</li> <li>Stay close enough to the product and the craft to make high-quality design decisions, not only set direction from a distance.</li> <li>Shape AI-native experiences that are clear, useful and trustworthy, including recommendations, conversational interfaces and next-best actions.</li> <li>Establish strong design principles for transparency, explainability, uncertainty, user control and safe escalation in a healthcare context.</li> <li>Build a high-performing design organisation, including hiring, coaching, talent development and second-line leadership.</li> <li>Create effective ways of working across Design, Product, Engineering, Medical, Data and Business.</li> <li>Help scale a coherent experience across countries, languages and different healthcare contexts.</li> <li>Connect design decisions to user behaviour, product outcomes and business impact.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What success looks like</strong></h2> <p>In your first year, you will have:</p> <ul> <li>established a clear and compelling design vision for the Patient stream;</li> <li>raised the quality bar across both core access-to-care journeys and newer Health Companion experiences;</li> <li>helped define a coherent interaction model for AI-powered patient experiences;</li> <li>strengthened collaboration between Design, Product, Engineering and Medical;</li> <li>developed a clear operating model and growth plan for the Patient Design organisation;</li> <li>helped Doctolib increase the value and relevance of the patient experience beyond appointment booking.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we are looking for</strong></h2> <p>You are likely to bring:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience leading Product Design, 10+ years in product design including 3+ years in people leadership..</li> <li>Experience in a consumer product organisation, ideally one used by millions of people.</li> <li>A track record of designing and scaling products across multiple markets, with an understanding of localisation, cultural differences and the balance between global consistency and local relevance.</li> <li>Experience managing at least five Product Designers, ideally a larger organisation including senior individual contributors and managers.</li> <li>Strong product design craft and creative judgement. You can recognise excellent work, make difficult quality trade-offs and stay close enough to the details to raise the standard of the product.</li> <li>Experience connecting design choices to measurable outcomes such as adoption, conversion, engagement, retention, satisfaction or user behaviour.</li> <li>A strong and practical understanding of AI-native product experiences. You have thought deeply about how AI changes interaction design, user expectations, trust, transparency and control.</li> <li>Experience designing with uncertainty, recommendations, personalisation or conversational interfaces is highly relevant.</li> <li>The ability to operate across complex products and stakeholders, while maintaining clarity and momentum.</li> <li>A concise and compelling communication style. You can articulate a clear point of view, align senior stakeholders and inspire teams to move in a new direction.</li> <li>Experience in healthcare or another regulated, trust-sensitive environment is valuable, but healthcare experience is not required. What matters is your respect for domain expertise and your ability to design responsibly in high-stakes contexts.</li> <li>Fluency in English. French or German would be a strong plus.</li> <li>A working style aligned with the Doctolib Playbook: User First, Medical Expertise, Forefront of Innovation, Bold, Drive, Passion, Humility.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Doctolib, why now?</strong></h2> <p>Doctolib gives you the opportunity to work on a consumer product with significant reach, strong European scale and a mission that matters.</p> <p>The patient product already has a large and engaged audience. The next challenge is to make the experience more useful, more contextual and more present in people’s everyday health journeys.</p> <p>You will join at a defining moment:</p> <ul> <li>Doctolib is moving from appointment booking towards continuous health support.</li> <li>AI is becoming a core part of the product experience, not an isolated feature.</li> <li>The Patient Design organisation is being strengthened and reshaped.</li> <li>The product must work across multiple European countries, languages and healthcare systems.</li> <li>The design foundations for the next chapter are still being built.</li> </ul> <p>This is an opportunity to shape a new category at the intersection of <strong>consumer product design, healthcare and AI</strong>, and to define how people will discover, understand and manage their health in the future.</p> <p> </p> <p><em>Doctolib is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better products and improve healthcare for more people. We welcome applications regardless of gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, ethnicity, disability or place of origin. If you have a disability, please let us know how we can make the recruitment process more accessible.</em></p> <p><em>Information submitted through this application is processed by Doctolib for recruitment purposes. For more information about data processing and your rights, please refer to our privacy policies:</em></p> <p><a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-FR"><em>France</em></a></p> <p><a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-DE"><em>Germany</em></a></p> <p><a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-IT"><em>Italy</em></a></p> <p><a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-COM"><em>The Netherlands</em></a></p> <p><em>For questions about data privacy, please contact ----- <p><br><br></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Pricing & Packaging Senior Lead (x/f/m)
description: <p>Wir suchen Dich als <strong>Pricing & Packaging Senior Lead (x/f/m) </strong>für unser Revenue Operations Team in <strong>Berlin</strong>.</p> <p>Doctolib bietet Arztpraxen in Deutschland ein Portfolio, das von Terminmanagement und Patientenkommunikation über KI-Assistenten für Telefon und Dokumentation bis zur vollständigen Praxissoftware reicht, vertrieben über Field Sales, Inside Sales, Customer Success und Partner. Du verantwortest die Preis- und Paketarchitektur dieses Portfolios: wie wir Preise differenzieren, was ein Einstiegspaket leisten muss, wie unsere Bundles aufgebaut sind und nach welcher Logik wir abrechnen.</p> <p>Die Rolle verbindet Strategie und Umsetzung. Du entwickelst Preisentscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlungsbereitschaft, Wettbewerb und Unit Economics, vertrittst sie gegenüber dem Leadership und sorgst dafür, dass sie im Markt so ankommen, wie sie gedacht sind: im Angebot der Seller:innen, in den Rabattregeln und im realisierten Preis.</p> <p>Nach sechs Monaten hast Du unsere Paketarchitektur auf den Prüfstand gestellt und die nächsten Schritte mit dem Leadership entschieden, eine erste Preis- oder Paketänderung umgesetzt und eine belastbare Sicht darauf aufgebaut, welcher Preis nach Rabatten tatsächlich realisiert wird.</p> <h2><strong>Deine Aufgaben</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Paketarchitektur:</strong> Du entwickelst unsere Paketstruktur vom Einstiegspaket bis zum Komplettangebot weiter und legst fest, welche Produkte und Leistungen wo liegen, wie sich die Stufen voneinander abgrenzen und welche Zusatzoptionen sie ergänzen</li> <li><strong>Preislogik und Differenzierung: </strong>Du definierst, worauf sich ein Preis bezieht, etwa pro Behandler:in, pro Praxis oder nach Nutzung, und wie wir nach Fachrichtung, Praxisgröße oder Vertragslaufzeit differenzieren</li> <li><strong>Evidenz und Business Cases:</strong> Du misst Zahlungsbereitschaft, analysierst Preiselastizität, Conversion und Churn nach Segment, beobachtest den Wettbewerb und rechnest mit Finance die Umsatz- und Margenwirkung jeder Option durch</li> <li><strong>Preisänderungen im Markt:</strong> Du planst Preisanpassungen und Paketwechsel für Neu- und Bestandskund:innen, inklusive Migrationslogik und Kommunikation, und begleitest sie bis in alle Sales Motions</li> <li><strong>Rabatt-Governance und Deal Desk:</strong> Du verantwortest Rabattregeln, Freigabelogik und Sonderkonditionen und machst transparent, wie viel vom Listenpreis tatsächlich realisiert wird</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Dein Profil</strong></h2> <p><em>Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!</em></p> <h3><strong>Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Du hast mehrere Jahre Pricing und Packaging in B2B-SaaS oder einem anderen Subscription-Geschäft gestaltet, im Unternehmen oder in der Pricing-Beratung, und Preis- oder Paketänderungen bis in den Markt gebracht</li> <li>Du weißt, wie man Zahlungsbereitschaft herausfindet, aus Kundengesprächen, Umfragen, Preistests im Markt und Daten zu Abschlüssen, Nutzung und Churn, und baust Deine Preis- und Margenmodelle selbst, in Spreadsheets und SQL</li> <li>Du übersetzt Analysen in klare Empfehlungen zu Preismetrik, Paketgrenzen und Preisniveau und vertrittst sie vor Senior Leadership und Sales Leadership</li> <li>Du setzt KI routiniert in Analyse und Arbeitsabläufen ein, z.B. für Wettbewerbs-Monitoring oder die Auswertung von Deal-Anfragen</li> <li>Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch und fließend Englisch</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Besonders interessant sind für uns außerdem:</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen, mit Health-Tech oder in einem anderen regulierten Markt</li> <li>Erfahrung mit nutzungsbasierten Preismodellen, Self-Service-Buchung oder Testphasen</li> <li>Erfahrung mit Rabatt-Governance, einem Deal Desk oder CPQ-Systemen</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Was wir Dir bieten</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Ein von Doctolib gesponsertes Deutschlandticket, wenn Du aus dem Büro oder im Hybridmodus arbeitest</li> <li>28 Urlaubstage + 1 Tag zusätzlich für jedes volle Beschäftigungs-Kalenderjahr (max. 30 Tage)</li> <li>Die Möglichkeit, 10 Tage im Jahr aus dem Ausland zu arbeiten</li> <li>Eine betriebliche Krankenzusatzversicherung mit individuellen Zusatzleistungen (u.a. Zahnreinigung u.v.m.)</li> <li>Eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (bAV) mit einem Arbeitgeberzuschuss von 40 % (15 % während der Probezeit)</li> <li>Teilnahme an Doctolibs langfristigem Mitarbeiterbeteiligungsprogramm DoctoGrowth</li> <li>Das Doctolib Parent Care Programm, das extra Elternzeit (1 Monat) u.v.m. enthält</li> <li>Kostenlose Mental Health- und Coaching-Sessions über einen externen Partner</li> <li>Zusätzlich zu gesunden Snacks und einem regelmäßigen Frühstücksbuffet, bieten wir Essensgutscheine</li> <li>Ein gefördertes Sportangebot mit unserem Partner Urban Sports Club</li> <li>Für pflegende Betreuungspersonen und Beschäftigte mit Behinderungen gibt es ein Angebot, das flexiblere Arbeitszeiten, zusätzliche Freistellung aus medizinischen Gründen und psychologische Unterstützung beinhaltet</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Der Interviewprozess</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Interview mit Deiner TA Partnerin</li> <li>Interview mit Deiner Manager</li> <li>Peer Interview</li> <li>Case Study Interview</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Job Details</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Festanstellung</li> <li>Vollzeit</li> <li>Arbeitsort: Berlin</li> <li>Hybride Arbeitsweise (3 Tage Office/Woche)</li> <li>Startdatum: ab sofort</li> </ul> <p><em>Wir verfolgen die Vision, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Dies spiegelt sich auch im Recruiting wider. Wir evaluieren Bewerbungen ausschließlich auf der Grundlage von Qualifikation und Motivation. Diskriminierung wird bei uns nicht toleriert.</em></p> <p><em>Je diverser unser Team und die Ideen sind, desto mehr wird unser Produkt die Gesundheit unserer Nutzer:innen verbessern können. Deshalb laden wir Dich ein, Dich bei uns zu bewerben, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Religion, Alter, sexueller Orientierung, ethnischer Herkunft oder Behinderung.</em></p> <p><em>Um Chancengleichheit zu gewährleisten, kannst Du in Deiner Bewerbung auf Angaben wie Fotos, Alter, etc. verzichten. Lass uns bitte wissen, welche Vorkehrungen wir treffen können, um Dich bestmöglich zu unterstützen. Wir freuen uns, mit Dir das Gesundheitswesen zu digitalisieren!</em></p> <p><em>Alle bereitgestellten Informationen werden von Doctolib für das Bewerbungsmanagement verarbeitet. Für Details zur Datenverarbeitung klicke bitte</em><a href="https://doctolib.legal/B2C-Privacy-Policy-Career-DE" target="_blank"><em> hier</em></a><em>.</em></p> <p><em>Bei Fragen oder wenn Du Deine Rechte wahrnehmen möchtest, wende Dich bitte an hr.dataprivacy(at)doctolib.com.</em></p> <p> </p> <p><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);">#LI-DC2</span></p> Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Solutions Engineer, New Business
description: <p><strong><em>OUR MISSION</em></strong></p> <p><strong>At Redwood, we empower our customers with lights-out automation for their mission-critical business processes.</strong></p> <p><strong><em>ABOUT US</em></strong></p> <p>Redwood Software is the leading orchestration platform for the autonomous enterprise, driving business transformation at the lowest total cost of ownership. Redwood empowers organizations to intelligently automate and orchestrate mission-critical business and IT processes across complex ERP, hybrid cloud, data and emerging agentic AI systems. Through its SaaS-first automation fabric—with AI embedded across the automation lifecycle—Redwood accelerates the path to autonomous operations. Backed by 30 years of experience and trusted by more than 50% of the Fortune 50, Redwood helps organizations unlock human potential to focus on innovation, growth and what’s next.</p> <p><strong><em>CORE VALUES</em></strong></p> <p>One Team. One Redwood</p> <p>Make Your Own Weather</p> <p>Obsess over Customer Success</p> <p>Work the Problem</p> <p>Be Curious</p> <p>Own the Outcome</p> <p>Respect Each Other</p> <p><strong><em>YOUR IMPACT</em></strong></p> <p>Gartner predicts that by 2029, 90% of organizations currently delivering workload automation will have transitioned to Service Orchestration and Automation Platforms (SOAPs) — a market expected to reach $4.9 billion by 2028. Redwood is the top-ranked vendor in Gartner's 2025 Critical Capabilities for SOAP, scoring #1 across all five use cases. We're expanding our Solutions Engineering team to meet that demand. In this role, you'll be the technical face of a category leader — helping enterprise prospects understand not just what Redwood does, but why it's the right answer in a market that's fundamentally changing.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Cover the full SOAP surface area.</strong> Present and position Redwood's capabilities across all five Gartner-defined SOAP use cases — IT workload automation, IT workflow orchestration, data orchestration, citizen/self-service automation, and DevOps automation. You won't be a deep expert in all five on day one, but you'll develop enough fluency to lead discovery and qualify the right fit for each prospect.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrate Redwood's platform with AI fluency.</strong> Deliver compelling technical presentations and live product overviews that connect Redwood's AI capabilities — AI-powered observability, intelligent job scheduling, and agentic orchestration — to concrete operational outcomes, not just platform features.</li> <li><strong>Use AI tools as a force multiplier.</strong> Leverage LLM-based research, prompt-driven workflows, and AI productivity tooling as a standard part of how you work — accelerating demo preparation, account research, competitive analysis, and technical documentation.</li> <li><strong>Position confidently in a competitive market.</strong> Develop a working understanding of the SOAP competitive landscape well enough to articulate Redwood's differentiation, handle objections live, and understand why you win and why you lose.</li> <li><strong>Drive technical evaluations hands-on.</strong> Lead proof-of-concept work with prospects to validate use cases and prove out business outcomes — including light scripting (REST APIs, Python, bash) where needed to close technical gaps.</li> <li><strong>Enable Account Executives.</strong> Provide technical insight, SOAP market context, and prospect feedback that sharpens messaging and accelerates new account acquisition.</li> <li><strong>Stay ahead of the SOAP and AI landscape.</strong> Continuously deepen your understanding of how the market is evolving — from agentic AI and GenAI-powered automation to data pipeline orchestration and self-service automation — and bring that context into every prospect conversation.</li> <li><strong>Uphold Redwood's standards.</strong> Maintain the highest ethical standards across all customer-facing work, representing the company with professionalism and technical credibility at every level of the prospect organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we're looking for in how you work:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Resourceful:</strong> You're constantly curious, proactively learning new AI tools and technical capabilities as part of how you operate — not as a side project.</li> <li><strong>Competitive:</strong> You bring initiative, confidence, and a results-oriented mindset to every pursuit.</li> <li><strong>Goal-Oriented:</strong> You set meaningful objectives, track them rigorously, and hold yourself accountable to outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Detail-Oriented:</strong> You're organized and exercise sound judgment — able to manage multiple technical evaluations and sales cycles simultaneously without things falling through.</li> <li><strong>Communicator:</strong> You can explain SOAP, AI, and automation concepts clearly to both a VP of Engineering and a CFO, and you know the difference matters.</li> <li><strong>Adaptable:</strong> You're comfortable shifting priorities and handling complex, dynamic requirements in a fast-moving enterprise sales environment.</li> </ul> <h2>YOUR EXPERIENCE</h2> <p>The most important thing we're hiring for is technical aptitude and intellectual curiosity. Domain knowledge can be taught — the ability to learn fast, think technically, and communicate clearly cannot.</p> <p><strong>What we require:</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>3+ years in a pre-sales, solutions engineering, or adjacent technical role</strong> in enterprise software — Process Automation, ERP, Data Integration, Business Intelligence, ESB, or similar.</li> <li><strong>Technical aptitude.</strong> Working knowledge of REST APIs and comfort with light scripting (Python, bash, or equivalent) sufficient to build simple integrations, validate technical scenarios, or debug issues in a demo environment. You don't need to be a software engineer — but you need to be comfortable in that world.</li> <li><strong>Demonstrated, hands-on use of AI tools in a professional context</strong> — LLMs, prompt-based workflows, AI-assisted research, AI productivity tooling. This is a baseline requirement, not a differentiator. Bonus if you understand how AI capabilities like observability, intelligent automation, and agentic orchestration are being embedded into enterprise automation platforms specifically.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with agentic AI and AI orchestration concepts.</strong> You understand what multi-agent systems are, how LLMs are being embedded into enterprise workflows, and can hold a substantive conversation with technical buyers about where this is headed.</li> <li><strong>High-level ERP literacy</strong> across core business processes: Financials, Procure to Pay, Plan to Build, Quote to Cash, Reporting, and Data Quality.</li> <li><strong>Ability to bridge technical depth and business value</strong> — credible in a room with enterprise architects, while equally effective communicating ROI to executive stakeholders.</li> <li><strong>Bachelor's degree</strong> from an accredited college or university.</li> </ul> <p><strong>A head start — not a hard filter. We'll invest in the rest:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior exposure to workload automation, job scheduling, or enterprise orchestration platforms.</li> <li>Familiarity with SAP environments — S/4HANA, RISE with SAP, SAP BTP, or core SAP business processes. We operate deeply in this ecosystem and will develop this knowledge in you.</li> <li>Awareness of data orchestration concepts — ETL/ELT pipelines, DataOps workflows, data movement across hybrid environments.</li> <li>Familiarity with DevOps toolchains and how automation intersects with CI/CD, infrastructure provisioning, or SRE practices.</li> <li>Experience in Customer Success, Technical Support, or Professional Services.</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><div class="css-1i27f3a"> <div class="css-ey7qxc"> <div class="css-1s1axh3" data-automation-id="jobPostingDescription"> <p><em>If you like growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!</em></p> <p> </p> <p><strong>THE LEGAL BIT</strong><br>Redwood is an equal opportunity employer. title: (Senior) Manager (m/w/d), Commodities & Energy Trading
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">About Baringa </span></h3> <p>Baringa is a global consulting firm that partners with leaders to drive change and create value. With deep industry expertise, and enabled by advanced technology, the firm helps clients to deliver with greater confidence and certainty. With over 2,000 people across the UK, Europe, North America, Asia and Australia, the firm combines global insight with local understanding.</p> <p>The firm works across energy and resources, financial services, government and public sector, consumer products and retail, pharmaceuticals and life sciences, manufacturing, and technology, media and telecoms, with capabilities spanning strategy, transformation and operational excellence – all powered by advanced technology, data, AI and digital innovation.</p> <p>Clients value Baringa’s collaborative approach and the way its teams integrate seamlessly – all working with a shared understanding of what matters most. The firm is known for its kind, curious experts who listen closely and care deeply about client success as they help clients transform energy markets, modernise financial platforms, expand telecoms and digital networks through advanced data analytics, enable digital services in government, and unlock growth in consumer sectors.</p> <p>Certified as a <em>Great Place to Work </em>around the world, Baringa has been recognised by the <em>Financial Times </em>in 22 categories of its UK Leading Management Consultants rankings, and by <em>Forbes </em>for four consecutive years as one of the World’s Best Management Consulting Firms.</p></div><h2><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif; color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">Our Commodities & Energy Trading practice is growing, and we are looking for (Senior) Managers (m/w/d) to join our team in Düsseldorf or Munich.</span> </span></h2> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">As a (Senior) Manager, you will lead or deliver complex management consulting engagements for clients across commodity and energy trading, build trusted relationships with senior decision-makers and help grow our practice. You will combine deep industry expertise with consulting and leadership skills, taking accountability for client outcomes, team performance and commercial development.</span></span></p> <p>We work with leading commodity and energy trading organisations, utilities and large energy consumers. Our work spans strategy, operating model and process design, trading transformation, commercial optimisation, risk and regulation, flexibility integration, and technology delivery.</p> <p>This is an opportunity to advise influential organisations on strategic priorities and deliver meaningful change across trading operations, commercial performance and new technologies, while playing a visible role in building our German and European business.</p> <p> </p> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">What you will be doing</span></span></h3> <p>You will take responsibility for delivering complex client engagements, leading project teams, building trusted client relationships and contributing to the growth of our Commodity & Energy Trading practice. The breadth of your responsibilities will reflect your experience and the level at which you join. Areas of work include:</p> <ul> <li><strong>Client leadership and delivery:</strong> Build trusted relationships with executive and senior client stakeholders, translate strategic priorities into practical programmes whilst owning complex engagements or major programmes from shaping through delivery, ensuring high-quality outcomes, strong governance and effective management of scope, risk and commercials.</li> <li><strong>Leadership & Business Development</strong><strong>:</strong> Identify and shape opportunities, lead proposals and pitches, develop propositions and account plans, and contribute to business development, revenue growth and capability building. Strengthen our market profile through thought leadership, external networks, sector insight and collaboration across Baringa capabilities and geographies.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Depending on your expertise, your client work may include:</span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Operating model & business transformation: </strong>Leading trading operating model and business transformation engagements, helping clients optimise governance, processes and organisational structures to deliver sustainable operational change.</li> <li><strong>Digital & trading transformation: </strong>Delivering data, analytics and AI-enabled transformation initiatives, helping clients improve trading decision-making, operational efficiency and commercial performance.</li> <li><strong>Trading systems transformation:</strong> Leading ETRM/CTRM transformation engagements, supporting strategy, implementation and optimisation initiatives while aligning business and technology stakeholders to achieve successful outcomes.</li> <li><strong>Flexibility services & integration: </strong>Leading the delivery of flexibility strategy and integration engagements, helping clients unlock value from battery storage, renewable assets and enabling technologies across evolving energy markets.</li> <li><strong>Risk and regulatory advisory: </strong>Advising clients on risk and regulatory challenges, enhancing risk management frameworks, governance and controls while supporting adaptation to evolving market and regulatory requirements.</li> </ul> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"> </span><br><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">Your skills and experience</span> </span></h3> <p>We are looking for experienced professionals who combine management consulting experience with strong knowledge of commodity and energy markets, ideally within energy and commodity trading or trading transformation. You do not need experience across every commodity or capability listed below. We are looking for deep expertise in at least one relevant area, together with the ability to solve complex client challenges:</p> <ul> <li>Significant experience delivering or leading complex consulting projects, transformation programmes or strategic initiatives.</li> <li>Deep expertise in at least one of Power, LNG, Gas & Clean Fuels, Metals or Oil, together with a strong understanding of trading organisations, markets and value chains.</li> <li>Relevant expertise in one or more of the following areas: trading operating models, business process improvement, ETRM/CTRM, data, analytics and AI, flexibility and optimisation, trading strategy and portfolio management, or risk and regulation.</li> <li>A track record of building trusted relationships with senior and executive stakeholders and influencing complex decisions.</li> <li>Demonstrated experience in business development, including shaping opportunities, leading proposals or pitches, and converting client needs into valuable work.</li> <li>Experience leading, coaching and developing project teams.</li> <li>Strong problem-solving, analytical and communication skills, with the ability to balance strategic thinking and hands-on delivery.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in German and English.</li> </ul> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;" data-ccp-props="{"134233117":true,"134233118":true,"201341983":2,"335559738":200,"335559739":0,"335559740":240}"> </span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none">What a career at Baringa will give you</span> </span></h2> <h3><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);">Putting</span> </span><span data-contrast="none"><span style="color: rgb(208, 0, 111);">People</span> </span><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142);"><span data-contrast="none">First.</span> </span></span></h3> <h3><span style="color: rgb(0, 53, 142); title: Werkstudent:in Social Media & Video Content
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>YOUR FUTURE, ON DEMAND</strong></p> <p>The ideal blend of stability and flexibility. A genuinely human employer that cares for people and the planet. True autonomy to shape what comes next, for us and you. This is the perfect platform to take your career where you want. </p> <p>Back in 2005, we pioneered Europe’s first TV streaming service. Today, we're a leading TV streaming provider with millions of monthly users, and since 2021 we've been ClimatePartner-certified. Over 200 colleagues of 47 nationalities. We’re the grown-up start-up, helping to shape a better future since day one.<strong> </strong>That hasn’t changed, even if the world has. We’re friendly, international, inclusive – and our people say we’re reliable and transparent, too. It’s why they trust us and believe in what we do.</p></div><p> </p> <p><strong>DIE ROLLE</strong></p> <p>TV-Streaming ist die Zukunft des Fernsehens – und Zattoo entwickelt dieses Erlebnis ständig weiter. Für unser Marketing-Team suchen wir eine:n Werkstudent:in, die/der unsere Video- und Visual-KanWe’äle auf Social Media eigenverantwortlich vorantreibt.</p> <p>Du begeisterst Dich für Serien, Sport, Shows und Filme und hast ein Gespür dafür, was auf Social Media funktioniert. Deine Ideen setzt Du selbst um, vom ersten Konzept bis zum fertigen Clip. Bei uns bekommst Du echte Verantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum in einem jungen Tech-Unternehmen.</p> <p>Idealerweise unterstützt Du uns 16–20 Stunden pro Woche.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>DAS CONSUMER TEAM</strong></p> <p>Das Consumer Team ist ein funktionsübergreifendes Team. Ob Performance-Marketing, SEO, Content, CRM, Social Media, Öffentlichkeitsarbeit, Lizenzierung, Platzierung und Verkauf von Online-Werbeflächen oder Kundensupport – wir arbeiten mit Begeisterung daran, Zattoo als die beste Alternative zum traditionellen Fernsehen zu positionieren.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>DAINE AUFGABEN</strong></span></p> <ul> <li>Du konzipierst, produzierst und schneidest Video-Content für YouTube und Instagram (Shorts, Reels, Stories).</li> <li>Du planst und pflegst den Redaktionsplan für unsere Social-Media-Kanäle.</li> <li>Du gestaltest Visuals für Posts, Thumbnails und Kampagnen.</li> <li>Du behältst TV- und Social-Media-Trends im Blick und machst daraus schnell passende Formate.</li> <li>Du wertest die Performance unserer Inhalte aus (z. B. in YouTube Studio und Instagram Insights) und leitest daraus Verbesserungen ab.</li> <li>Du unterstützt die Zusammenarbeit mit Creator:innen sowie die Abstimmung mit TV-Sendern und Content-Partnern.</li> <li>Du unterstützt Website-Projekte in unserem CMS.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p><strong>DEIN PROFIL</strong></p> <ul> <li>Du bist an einer Hochschule eingeschrieben, idealerweise in Medien, Kommunikation, Marketing, Film, Design oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich.</li> <li>Du hast bereits Berufserfahrung im Bereich Social Media oder Content gesammelt, z. B. in einem Praktikum, einem Werkstudentenjob oder einer Agentur.</li> <li>Du schneidest sicher Videos im Hochformat (z. B. mit CapCut, Premiere Pro oder DaVinci Resolve) und gestaltest ansprechende Visuals (z. B. mit Canva oder Photoshop).</li> <li>Du kennst die Formate und Mechaniken von YouTube, Instagram und TikTok – nicht nur als Nutzer:in.</li> <li>Du arbeitest selbstständig und strukturiert und bringst proaktiv eigene Ideen ein.</li> <li>Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und hast gute Englischkenntnisse.</li> <li>Erfahrung mit KI-Tools für Video, Bild oder Text ist ein Plus.</li> </ul> <p><strong><br>WARUM ZATTOO? </strong></p> <p>Bei Zattoo stehst Du immer auf festem Boden, mit wahrer Freiheit, Dich zu entfalten. Du bekommst die Unterstützung und die Möglichkeiten, die Du brauchst, um weit zu kommen, während Du uns dabei hilfst, eine nachhaltige und unterhaltsame Zukunft für alle zu schaffen.</p> <p> </p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>WAS WIR DIR BIETEN</strong></span></p> <ul> <li><strong>Entlohnung</strong>: wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt</li> <li><strong>Investieren</strong>: wertvolle Berufserfahrung, Betreuung und Wachstumschancen</li> <li><strong>Entlastung</strong>: Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit für Telearbeit (Remote) für bis zu 8 Wochen pro Jahr</li> </ul> <p>Plus</p> <ul> <li><strong>Wir teilen</strong>: Kostenloser Zugriff auf das beste TV-Streaming auf dem Markt</li> <li><strong>Wir bilden weiter</strong>: Zugang zu Lernangeboten wie internen Schulungen, Deutschunterricht und Hackdays</li> <li><strong>Wir sind integrativ</strong>: "Zattooies" sind ein lustiges, engagiertes und vielfältiges Team, das sich aus 47 Nationalitäten zusammensetzt.</li> <li><strong>Wir sind gesund</strong>: Gesundheitschecks, Unterstützung für das psychische Wohlbefinden, Teamsport und mehr! </li> <li><strong>Wir sind gesellig</strong>: ein Veranstaltungskalender mit Kamingesprächen, Team-Mittagessen, hauseigene Bar (Zaloon), Grillabende, monatliche Zusammenkünfte, Sommerfest und einem jährlichen Off-Site-Event</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p>Zattoo enables our users to view indiscriminately and we reflect that in our team too. Regardless of race, gender, sexual orientation, religion, national origin, age, disability or any other characteristic protected by law we encourage everyone to apply and will give everyone equal consideration. We are an equal opportunities employer — join us and help build a diverse team dedicated to revolutionising the way you watch TV.</p> <p>We are committed to ensuring fair, open, and equitable hiring practices and are happy to answer any questions you may have about us or the role throughout the whole process. In line with the EU Pay Transparency Directive, we share the applicable compensation range with you before your first interview.</p> <p class="text-justify">You can learn more about us at: <a href="https://zattoo.com/company/jobs/">https://zattoo.com</a></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

title: Unsolicited Application (all genders)
description: Unsolicited Application (all genders) Thorit GmbH · Böblingen or Lisbon · Various employment types · Open year round None of the open positions fits your skillset or passion? You don't need a formal cover letter, but we'd love a short note on which area you see yourself in and what draws you to an agentic consultancy. title: Sales Manager
description: Your Impact We have built a sales machine that works: ~90% of our AEs hit quota, our top performers achieve significantly more, we rarely lose head to head, and almost nobody who buys Tacto ever leaves. The bottleneck is no longer the market or the product, it is leadership capacity. We need managers who can turn good AEs into great ones at the speed we are hiring them. As Sales Manager you own one customer segment and lead a team of ~5 Account Executives. You carry no personal quota. Your number is your team's number, and your job is the thing that produces it: the quality of your people, the rigor of your deal strategy, and the discipline of your pipeline. You will work directly with the founders and sales leadership on how we go to market in a segment where over 10,000 industrial companies in DACH still run procurement on Excel, and where we are the category of one. Your Tasks Own your segment's number through your team : You are measured on team attainment. You build the pipeline coverage, forecast accuracy, and win rates that make the number inevitable. Team Development: Build and coach a high-performing sales team through structured training, hands-on deal support, and performance management. You'll model best practices while developing each team member's capabilities. Deal Strategy & Execution: Actively join critical customer conversations, challenge assumptions, eliminate risks, and design winning game plans alongside your AEs. You'll roll up your sleeves to support negotiations and business case development. Sales Excellence: Implement and coach on proven sales methodologies (MEDDIC) while creating a culture of continuous improvement through regular training in discovery, negotiation, and process management. Performance Optimization: Drive team performance through structured metrics tracking, pipeline reviews, and action planning. You'll identify improvement opportunities and implement solutions that increase win rates and deal velocity. Become AI Native: Proactively identify opportunities to leverage AI to accelerate the work of your team, experiment with new approaches, and share successful workflows – contributing to Tacto's culture of high-velocity execution and innovation. Your Profile 3+ years as an Account Executive in B2B SaaS with complex, non-transactional, multi-stakeholder sales At least 1 year leading a sales team, ideally in a high-growth environment A track record of consistently hitting or beating quota, as an individual and with a team You coach from a real methodology, not from instinct, and you can teach it to someone who does not have it yet You are strategic and tactical in the same week: you can design a segment plan on Monday and rescue a stalled deal on Thursday You are direct. You give hard feedback early because you would rather have the uncomfortable conversation than watch someone miss Resilient, high-agency, and drawn to a hard problem over an easy title Fluent in German and English Why this role is awesome Product-market fit is not a hypothesis here. Customers stay, they grow, and our product team ships against a real vision, so every quarter your AEs walk into calls with something they could not say the quarter before. That means you will not spend your first year explaining why anyone should care. You will spend it coaching sellers who are ambitious, hungry to grow, and carry almost no ego about it, the kind who ask for feedback and then act on it. Whatever you have learned in your career lands on fertile soil here. Why Tacto A standout sales organization built for the long term ~90% of AEs hit their quota, with top performers reaching up to 400% Incentives that reward over-performance: 150% uncapped kicker No compromises on the talent bar: a lean, high-density team of A-players who push each other, with zero elbow culture. We hire the best, incentivize them right, and promote from within.
