Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>We build products at the intersection of AI, search and retrieval, data insights, and product engineering.</p> <p>As AI agents change how people discover and interact with the Internet, new problems are emerging around how content is found, understood, retrieved, and kept current. Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to help website owners make their content discoverable and to help agents find relevant, trustworthy information across our network. Building these capabilities requires solving problems across distributed systems, crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval quality, developer experience, and reliable product delivery.</p> <p>Cloudflare also has a unique perspective on how the Internet is changing. Our global network observes signals that can help us understand trends, identify when content changes, and measure the pulse of the Internet. Used responsibly, these signals could improve existing products, help customers and AI companies find fresher and more relevant information, and create entirely new capabilities and products. The opportunity is broad and still evolving. We need to deliver excellent products today while continuing to identify the problems Cloudflare is uniquely positioned to solve next.</p> <p>We are a tight-knit group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead engineering across some of our AI and Internet Data Insights portfolio.</p> <p>You will be responsible for the people, execution, and engineering quality behind products that help customers make their content discoverable and turn complex Internet signals into useful experiences. You will partner closely with Product Management and engineering teams across Cloudflare to deliver current priorities and shape future opportunities. This is a management role for someone who is deeply technically credible. You will not be expected to write most of the code, but you should be able to understand the systems your engineers operate, challenge architectural decisions, ask the right questions when something is going wrong, and step into a technical problem when the situation calls for it.</p> <p>At the same time, we are looking for a manager, not a tech lead with direct reports. Your success will be measured by the quality and output of the team you build, the engineers you develop, and the systems and products they deliver.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <h4><strong>What you'll do</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Manage, coach, and grow engineers working across AI-powered search, Internet data insights, and customer-facing products.</li> <li>Own execution by establishing clear priorities, creating predictable delivery, and giving engineers the context and autonomy to own meaningful areas of the product.</li> <li>Lead the development of search and retrieval capabilities that help people and AI agents find relevant, trustworthy, and current content.</li> <li>Partner closely with Product Management to understand customer problems, shape the roadmap, and turn broad opportunities into clear engineering outcomes.</li> <li>Help identify how signals from Cloudflare's global network can produce useful and trustworthy insights for customers, partners, and other Cloudflare products.</li> <li>Explore where Cloudflare's unique view of Internet activity can improve content discovery, enable new product experiences, or support entirely new products.</li> <li>Balance near-term product delivery with thoughtful technical investments that allow promising ideas to grow.</li> <li>Own the operational health of the systems in your area, including observability, incident response, data and search quality, and long-term reliability.</li> <li>Develop technical leaders and create space for engineers to lead architecture and implementation.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h4> <p>We want you to love it here. This role is a great fit for you if:</p> <ul> <li>You have led and developed high-performing engineering team(s) and can point to what that team shipped and how the people on it grew.</li> <li>You are technically credible with experienced engineers. You can review a design, understand the trade-offs in a distributed system or data platform, and recognize when a technical problem needs deeper investigation.</li> <li>You are comfortable managing a team working across several related technical areas and can create clarity without requiring every problem to fit neatly into a single box.</li> <li>You care deeply about reliability and quality, particularly when the output of a system is data that people use to understand the Internet.</li> <li>You have strong product judgment and enjoy working with Product Management to decide what is worth building, what needs improvement and what should not be built at all.</li> <li>You are comfortable with ambiguity and with finding structure in areas where the opportunity is clearer than the roadmap.</li> <li>You communicate clearly, give direct feedback, and can explain complex technical decisions to both engineers and non-engineers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Examples of Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong technical grounding in distributed systems, search systems, data-intensive systems, Internet infrastructure, or adjacent areas.</li> <li>Experience building or operating products involving crawling, content ingestion, indexing, retrieval, analytics, or large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Experience operating systems where correctness, reliability, and quality matter as much as feature delivery.</li> <li>A track record of hiring, developing, and retaining strong engineers.</li> <li>Experience partnering closely with Product Management to shape and execute a roadmap.</li> <li>Experience taking products or major capabilities from an ambiguous opportunity to a clear customer outcome.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Familiarity with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), which combines information retrieval with generative AI to produce Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><span style="font-size: 12pt;"><strong>Available Locations: Lisbon</strong></span></p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Department</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Team</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We build the tooling and platform capabilities that power the next generation of AI agents on the Cloudflare Developer Platform. Our goal is to make it easier for agents to interact with the web, and to be observed and controlled while they do it — without giving up performance, scalability or security.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the centre of that work, and it is the product this role owns. It is also a billed product on a steep growth curve, which makes capacity, cold-start latency, concurrency limits and abuse protection product problems rather than merely operational ones.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">The team’s wider portfolio includes an agent-first browser built on Workers rather than containers, a managed CI platform for the agent development lifecycle, visual regression testing delivered as a service, a pre-rendering service, URL Scanner, and CDNJS. That pace is the point, and it is the thing this role has to make sustainable.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We are a tight-knit team that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to the highest standard.</span></p> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About the Role</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">This is a hands-on engineering management role. You will own Browser Run engineering end to end — the people, the roadmap, the reliability, and the story we tell customers about it. You will report to the Senior Engineering Manager for AI Agents Tooling & Platform and partner closely with Product Management, Developer Relations, and platform teams across Cloudflare.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Browser Run is the primary focus. The team owns other products, and there is scope for some of them to move into your remit as the role and the team grow, but we are hiring someone to make Browser Run excellent first.</span></p> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">You will not be writing most of the code. External developers and other Cloudflare teams depend on this service.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Keep the automation surface honest: Puppeteer and Playwright compatibility, CDP behaviour that matches what developers expect from a local Chrome, and a credible story for Chrome version upgrades.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Develop leaders. Identify and grow the engineers who will run day-to-day delivery for an area of the product, and hand that work to them.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Resolve cross-team dependencies with the Workers, Developer Platform, Security and Billing teams, and bring contentious technical decisions to closure quickly and calmly.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Own the commercial mechanics of a billed service, including the unglamorous parts: usage metering, quotas, plan limits, abuse protection and pricing input.</span></li> <li style="font-size: 12pt;"><span style="font-size: 12pt;">Represent Browser Run externally through launch blog posts, developer documentation, conference talks and direct customer conversations.</span></li> </ul> <p> </p> <h2><span style="font-size: 12pt;">About you</span></h2> <p><span style="font-size: 12pt;">We want you to love it here. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2> <ul> <li>Bengaluru, India</li> </ul> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>The Cloudflare Business Development team is the engine driving our expansion across global markets. As part of this high-energy organization, you will lead a critical team focused on the SAARC region, uncovering new opportunities and shaping pipeline strategy. We pride ourselves on being principled in our approach, curious about our customers' challenges, and completely transparent in how we collaborate. The Business Development team sits at the intersection of Sales, Marketing, and Operations, serving as a vital incubator for top-tier sales talent and a primary catalyst for regional revenue growth.</p> <p>We are seeking a strategic, growth-minded <strong>Business Development Representative (BDR) Manager</strong> to lead, coach, and scale our Business Development team supporting the SAARC region. In this role, you will manage a team of 5 BDR professionals, overseeing day-to-day operations, driving quota performance, and building a sustainable pipeline. You will be responsible for the full talent lifecycle—from recruiting and interviewing to onboarding and continuous professional development.</p> <p>This role requires a collaborative leader who can build strong bridges with regional Sales leadership, global Marketing teams, and Sales Operations to optimize lead flows, elevate campaign effectiveness, and continuously improve internal processes.</p> <h2>Responsibilities</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Team Leadership & Performance Management:</strong> Direct daily activities and quota attainment for a team of 5 BDRs, ensuring regional pipeline objectives and performance metrics are consistently met or exceeded.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Talent Development & Coaching:</strong> Empower team members through structured 1:1 coaching, regular skill development, and creative performance incentives. Foster a growth mindset that prepares BDRs for future career advancement.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Talent Acquisition & Onboarding:</strong> Manage regional recruiting, interviewing, and hiring to scale the team efficiently. Own the onboarding framework, ensuring new hires ramp quickly through robust training on product knowledge, buyer personas, market competition, and tools.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategic Execution:</strong> Lead from the front to support regional success; while this is a management role, you are comfortable adopting a "player-coach" mindset where necessary to help the team break into strategic accounts or navigate complex regional roadblocks.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration:</strong> Partner deeply with key stakeholders across the business:</p> <ul> <li> <p><em>Sales:</em> Align on qualification criteria, handoff processes, and pipeline quality to ensure seamless lead transitions.</p> </li> <li> <p><em>Marketing:</em> Maximize the volume and quality of Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs), refine messaging, and optimize campaign follow-ups.</p> </li> <li> <p><em>Operations:</em> Analyze metrics and reporting to identify bottlenecks and implement process enhancements.</p> </li> </ul> </li> <li> <p><strong>Data-Driven Optimization:</strong> Regularly track and report on individual and team metrics—focusing on lead quality, volume, and revenue impact—to regional Sales leadership.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Operational Excellence:</strong> Continuously evaluate and implement industry best practices to improve prospecting efficiency, team productivity, and outbound messaging.</p> </li> </ul> <h2>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</h2> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Leadership Experience:</strong> Demonstrated experience managing, coaching, or leading outbound sales or business development professionals, ideally within a high-growth SaaS or technology environment.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Market Knowledge:</strong> Deep understanding of the SAARC business ecosystem, localized buying behaviors, and corporate cultural dynamics.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Sales Execution:</strong> Proven track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline generation and quota objectives, with a strong understanding of modern prospecting frameworks and methodologies.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> Excellent stakeholder management skills with a history of building productive partnerships across Sales, Marketing, and Enablement teams.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Analytical Mindset:</strong> Proficiency with sales tech stacks (e.g., Salesforce, Outreach) and the ability to leverage data to evaluate team performance, uncover trends, and refine processes.</p> </li> <li> how detection rules degrade, and how to build systems that stay ahead of evolving attack techniques.</li> <li>Collaborate with Threat Intelligence researchers, Trust & Safety analysts, Product, Legal, and other engineering teams to translate complex security and compliance requirements into scalable, production-grade solutions.</li> <li>Mentor and elevate the engineering talent around you — set the bar for code quality, system design, operational rigor, and security-first thinking across both organizations.</li> <li>Develop and champion agentic AI workflows and AI-assisted development practices that accelerate threat hunting, detection engineering, and abuse investigation.</li> <li>Own the operational excellence of the systems you touch, including participation in on-call rotations and incident response.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:</strong></h4> <ul> <li>15+ years of cyber security experience with an emphasis on building systems to present adversarial trends and techniques both as an internal reputational service and a product facing analyst service.</li> <li>10+ years of experience building and operating large-scale distributed systems in production, with demonstrated expertise in complex system architecture and design.</li> <li>Deep, hands-on proficiency in Go and/or TypeScript, with production experience deploying services in Kubernetes and on edge computing platforms (e.g., Cloudflare Workers, D1/SQLite-at-the-edge).</li> <li>Subject matter expertise in threat intelligence, adversarial analysis, or detection engineering — you understand the Cyber Kill Chain, know how to track TTPs, and can reason about attacker infrastructure at scale.</li> <li>Proven ability to work across organizational boundaries and lead technical initiatives that span multiple teams, codebases, and problem domains simultaneously.</li> <li>Experience with AI-assisted development and agentic AI workflows.</li> <li>Strong architectural judgment — you know when to build, when to refactor, and when to burn it down and start over.</li> <li>Experience designing and operating critical data pipelines (Kafka, Temporal, or similar) and working with SQL databases (PostgreSQL) and caching layers (Redis) at scale.</li> <li>Excellent communication skills — you can explain a complex system design to a VP and debug a race condition with a junior engineer in the same afternoon.</li> <li>A track record as a disruptor: you have examples of fundamentally improving how a team, system, or organization operates, not just shipping features.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus Points:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Experience in the Trust & Safety or platform abuse domain — phishing detection, malware analysis, fraud prevention, or content moderation at scale.</li> <li>Proficiency in writing detection rules using YARA, Snort, or similar detection languages.</li> <li>Experience analyzing adversary TTPs across web-based threat vectors, including phishing obfuscation techniques (HTML encoding, JavaScript redirects, Base64, embedded scripts).</li> <li>Familiarity with Rust.</li> <li>Experience with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices.</li> <li>Prior experience building threat intelligence platforms, IOC distribution systems, or automated mitigation pipelines.</li> <li>Experience with React for internal tooling and analyst-facing applications.</li> <li>Deep understanding of DNS, TLS/SSL, HTTP, and web security standards.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations: Washington, D.C.</h2> <h2>What you’ll do as a Senior Customer Engineer, Public Sector Federal</h2> <p>You are the technical lynchpin through the entire sales cycle - pre-sales and account technical leadership. When hiring we look for diversity of experience combined with genuine curiosity for our technology.</p> <p>Ultimately, you are passionate about technology and have the ability to explain complex technical concepts in easy-to-understand terms. Reminder: this is not a strict requirement at all. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>Experience serving the US Department of Defense or DISA market segment</li> </ul> <h3>Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Graduate-level degrees in Computer Science, Engineering or related fields. Candidates from all walks of life are welcome.</li> <li>Certifications: Azure/AWS/GCP Architect, etc.</li> </ul> <h3>More About You</h3> <ul> <li>You can translate technical concepts and jargon for a wide variety of audiences: from systems engineers, to front-end developers, through to IT managers and C-levels in enterprise organizations.</li> <li>You want to be constantly learning new things and teaching what you've learned to the broader team through internal and external blog posts, team demos, and product training sessions.</li> <li>You have a knack for understanding problems and finding creative ways to solve them. title: Senior Customer Engineer, Saudi Arabia
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3><strong>Available Location: Dubai, UAE<br></strong></h3> <hr> <h3><strong>What you will do as a Customer Engineer</strong></h3> <p>The Customer Engineer (CE) is the core driver of our technical go-to-market strategy: a trusted technical advisor and primary architect of the customer journey. You will bridge the gap between technical strategy and business value—guiding enterprise clients from initial pre-sales technical validation through onboarding, deployment architecture, and full lifecycle expansion. Sitting within the GTM organization and reporting to a Customer Engineering Leader, you will not hand off your customers once an initial agreement is reached. Instead, you will operate as a quota-carrying technologist, leveraging AI-augmented workflows to eliminate administrative toil so you can focus on high-value architectural design and driving measurable business outcomes across the entire customer journey.</p> <p><strong>Regional Focus:</strong> <strong>Saudi Arabia</strong></p> <p><strong>Key Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Technical Validation: </strong>Partner closely with Account Executives to lead technical deep-dive discovery, capture business requirements, and map complex customer infrastructure - DNS, CDN, Zero Trust, Network Security, Workers - to fit-for-purpose Cloudflare architectures and bespoke solutions. . Define, scope, success criteria, and technical evaluations plans for Proof of Concepts (PoCs) and Technical Validations. Deliver tailored technical presentations, architectural diagrams, and demonstrations that show how Cloudflare solves specific performance, security, and reliability challenges. Proactively address complex technical objections, security compliance questions, and edge-case architectural requirements during the sales cycle. Take accountability for a suitable solution deployment strategy (Customer, Partner or Cloudflare Professional services) being an integral part of all proposals.</li> <li><strong>Customer Adoption & Value Realization: </strong>Provide oversight to technical onboarding and implementation, but not execute the implementation, serving as the primary executive and engineering contact for the customer. Design structured migration and onboarding blueprints tailored to the customer’s environment (e.g. DNS migrations, Zero Trust rollouts, WAF tuning guidance), and act as the lead consultant for customer engineering teams, walking them step-by-step through configuration best practices.  Partner with Account Executives to own discovery, demos, onboarding, technical health, risk, and expansion strategy. Proactively monitor customer health scores and telemetry to ensure rapid time-to-value, resolve integration bottlenecks, and reduce deployment risk.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Accountability & Expansion: </strong>Carry a variable quota tied directly to new business acquisition and/or ongoing account growth. Be commercially accountable for ensuring deep platform adoption, retaining revenue, and identifying strategic cross-sell and up-sell opportunities based on product usage data. Lead technical Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to translate platform capabilities into return on investment for C-level executives.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Advisory: </strong>Act as a trusted technical advisor throughout the entire customer lifecycle, maintaining a continuous, deep relationship with key stakeholders from initial onboarding through maturity, renewal, and expansion. Provide thought partnership on architecture, AI control layers, security posture, and deployment confidence. Identify potential deployment risks or integration bottlenecks early, and provide remediation strategies to de-risk customer outcomes. </li> <li><strong>AI Orchestration & Workflow Automation: </strong>Leverage AI agents, Large Language Models (LLMs), and internal platforms to automate routine tasks such as RFP/Security Questionnaire responses, sandbox provisioning, basic telemetry monitoring, and internal/external documentation, reclaiming your time for strategic customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Education & Enablement:</strong> Partner closely with the Enablement Team to design, build, and govern technical resources. Define, document, and educate both internal teams and customers on deliverables such as Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), architectural best practices, and technical guides to continuously raise the technical baseline across the organization.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li>Fluency in English and Arabic (written and spoken).</li> <li>Experience: Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Professional Services,  Sales Engineering, Technical Account Management, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer (years of experience required will vary based on Associate, Senior, Staff, or Principal leveling).</li> <li>Architectural Mindset: Ability to white-board, design, and articulate complex enterprise network and security architectures clearly.</li> <li>Consultative & Advisory Skills: Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate deeply technical concepts into business outcomes for both hands-on engineers and C-level executives.</li> <li>Commercial Mindset: Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li>Communication: Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> <li>Technical Breadth: We do not expect every candidate to be an expert in every domain. Qualified candidates will demonstrate depth in at least four of the technical areas below:</li> <ul> <li>Internet fundamentals: Deep understanding of how the Internet works, including OSI Model layers 1–7, BGP, GRE, TCP/UDP, DNS (authoritative and recursive), HTTP(S), and SSL/TLS.</li> <li>Security: Expertise in the security of Internet properties, including WAF, Bot Management, Firewalls, Rate Limiting, (M)TLS, Zero Trust, and SASE concepts.</li> <li>Performance: Expertise in the performance of Internet properties, including speed, latency, caching, video streaming, HTTP/2, and TLS 1.3.</li> <li>AI Proficiency: Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI-assisted scripting and log analysis, LLM utilization, and workflow automation to augment everyday CE workflows.</li> <li>Coding/Scripting: Proficiency in Python, JavaScript, Bash, Lua, Go, or similar languages to write custom integration scripts, API connectors, and edge computing functions.</li> <li>Developer Platform Fluency: Experience designing, building, deploying or scaling applications using RESTful/GraphQL APIs, SDKs, webhooks, and developer tooling in cloud-native environments. Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD pipelines, and observability for developer-led deployments.</li> </ul> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Qualifications (The "Good-to-Haves")</strong></p> <ul> <li>Technical Enablement: Track record of creating and delivering technical enablement - workshops, code samples, documentation, or developer onboarding - that accelerates customer adoption of complex platforms. </li> <li>Applied AI Knowledge: Experience with LLM orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) architectures, and model-access controls.</li> <li>Regulatory Knowledge: Understanding of regulatory requirements such as PCI DSS, HIPAA, and SOC 2.</li> <li>Hyperscaler / Digital Native Background: Talent coming out of hyperscalers, digital natives, distributed systems environments, or startups is strongly valued for its deeper cloud fluency and advanced architecture depth.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Education</strong></p> <p>Undergraduate or graduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. </p> <p><strong>Travel</strong></p> <p>This role may require travel up to 20–50% to attend customer meetings, conferences, industry events, and in-person team collaboration.</p> <p> </p> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div> <div id="te-floating-button-container"></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. strategic customer advisory.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Minimum Qualifications</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Experience:</strong> Experience in a customer-facing technical role, such as Solutions Engineering, Customer Engineering, Sales Engineering, or as a Forward Deployed Engineer.</li> <li><strong>Technical Acumen:</strong> Broad technical expertise spanning web security, networking (routing, DNS, DDoS mitigation), cloud infrastructure, and enterprise architecture.</li> <li><strong>Commercial Mindset:</strong> Proven track record of operating in a quota-carrying or revenue-aligned environment, with a strong understanding of SaaS metrics, business value translation, and enterprise sales cycles.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Exceptional presentation and stakeholder management skills, capable of bridging the gap between deep technical implementation details and high-level C-suite business strategy.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Strongly Preferred Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h2>Available Locations</h2><ul><li>Bengaluru, India</li></ul><h2>About the Role</h2><p>The Senior OIC and OPA Developer is the definitive technical expert responsible for developing, governing, and standardizing all data movement and orchestration involving the Oracle Fusion ERP Cloud environment. This role designs the most complex and critical integration patterns using Oracle Integration Cloud and Oracle Process Automation ensuring technical solutions adhere to Enterprise Architecture and security standards.</p><h2>Responsibilities</h2><ul><li>Complex Integration Design: Architect and develop the most challenging, cross-functional, and real-time integration patterns for the Oracle Fusion program using Oracle Integration Cloud.</li><li>Architecture & Governance: Act as the technical gatekeeper for all Oracle integration and process automation design, ensuring strict adherence to enterprise standards. Define the long-term technical roadmap for the OIC/OPA platform.</li><li>Technical Development: Personally drive the design and development of technical solutions (Interfaces, Conversions, Orchestrations and Workflows) within OIC, utilizing REST, SOAP, ERP, FTP, Other Application-specific Standard and Database adapters. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. title: Senior Partner Engineer
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Available Locations: Miami FL, Atlanta GA, Charlotte NC, Raleigh NC (Southeast Territory)</strong></p> <p><strong>Role Overview</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Partner Engineer (PE)</strong> is a high-impact, strategic technical sales leader  responsible for end-to-end technical lifecycle and enablement of the assigned partners, managing both pre-sales and post-sales engineering activities. Pre-Sales Engineering & Champion Building</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Technical Alignment, Discovery & Enablement: </strong>Own the technical relationship with Partners to align on building joint Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies. Act as the primary architect mapping partner business goals to technical execution milestones, ensuring continuous alignment on CF1 and AI adoption targets.Building Technical Champions: Identify, enable, and cultivate key technical advocates and "Champions" within the partner organization to scale Cloudflare expertise independently, generate Partner-Influenced Opportunities (PIO), and empower them to deliver high-value professional services around Zero Trust and AI application security.Driving PIO via Next-Gen Architectures: Collaborate with sales teams to proactively source, qualify, and expand PIO through strategic architectural alignment, focusing on migrating legacy network architectures to CF1 and integrating secure AI solutions.Deal Support & Qualification: Enable partners' technical validation, proof-of-concept (PoC), demo, pipeline generation, and pipeline acceleration capabilities. Identify joint pursuit accounts, facilitate strategic technical account planning, and deliver cutting-edge solution architecture sessions for Named Partners </li> </ul> <p><strong>2. Accelerate Services Delivery</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>ASD Partner Journey Ownership:</strong> Own the ASD partner journey to ensure partners possess the advanced capabilities required to deploy, manage, and support the Cloudflare platform and AI application workloads seamlessly.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Joint Services Offering Acceleration with strong focus on CF1 and A1</strong>: Build and co-develop joint services catalogues with key partners, accelerating the creation and launch of their own Cloudflare-focused services offerings, managed CF1 SASE practices, and AI security assessments.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Service Monetization & Performance Metrics: </strong>Enable partners to embed CF1 and Workers AI capabilities into their own managed security portfolios to shorten time-to-market, protect client AI pipelines, and maximize profitability. Develop, manage, and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure and improve the effectiveness of these partner service deliveries</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Technical Account Management & Architectural Health:</strong> Act as the escalated technical point of contact to ensure long-term architectural health, utilizing telemetry and proactive design to move the partner relationship from reactive to strategics for Cloudflare.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>3. Automation AI Agents & Continuous Innovation</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Leverage Autonomous AI Tools:</strong> Champion the use of Cloudflare OS and AI tools (Agent PAT and Agent Echo) to automate standard, repeatable technical tasks, optimizing operational efficiency and freeing up bandwidth for high-touch, strategic partner engagements.</li> <li><strong>AI & CF1 Product Enhancement Feedback Loop:</strong> Engage partner champions in the Partner Technical Advisory Council (PTAC) to give them early access to beta software, capture raw product feedback, and drive joint co-innovation on CF1 features and emerging AI products.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Enablement:</strong> Participate in continuous cross-training programs to maintain peak proficiency in both pre-sales scoping and post-sales service deployment across the entire Cloudflare One and AI ecosystem.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Required Qualifications & Experience</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>8+ years of technical, partner-facing experience (e.g., Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, or Technical Account Manager) in cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, or networking.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong technical depth in Cloudflare One (CF1) or equivalent SASE/SSE architectures, Zero Trust, DNS, and application security, alongside hands-on familiarity with AI deployment, AI Gateway, LLM orchestration frameworks, or vector databases.</p> </li> <li> <p>Proven track record of developing technical talent or building "champion" programs within partner organizations, specifically driving adoption of complex cloud networks and AI technologies.</p> </li> <li> <p>Enterprise Architecture & Project Management: Deep understanding of enterprise IT, multi-cloud, and hybrid cloud environment while managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders</p> </li> <li> <p>Demonstrated ability to manage the technical lifecycle of a deal from initial pre-sales discovery and CF1/AI PIO generation through post-sale service delivery.</p> </li> <li> <p>Strong communication skills with a track record of presenting complex CF1 architectures and AI-driven use cases to partner leadership and technical teams alike.</p> </li> <li> <p>Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.</p> </li> </ul> <h3 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h3> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,1,0">For SF, SJ, and Bay Area Metro based hires: Estimated annual salary of $244,000-336,000.</p> </li> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,2,0">For Boston, California - Remote, Connecticut - Remote, DC Metro, Massachusetts - Remote, New Jersey - Remote, New York City, NY Metro, Remote - Washington, Washington (Kirkland), and Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $234,000-$321,000.</p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_1490b3c2ae43d783-39" data-path-to-node="1,3,0">For Illinois - Remote, Maryland - Remote, Minnesota - Remote, Nevada - Remote, New York - Remote, Rhode Island - Remote, and Vermont - Remote based hires: Estimated annual salary of $212,000-$292,000</p> </li> <li> <p id="p-rc_1490b3c2ae43d783-40" data-path-to-node="1,4,0"><span class="citation-516 citation-end-516">This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare's Sales Compensation Plan. At Cloudflare, we are biased for action, we prioritize shipping early, gathering data, and iterating rapidly.</li> <li><strong>Go-to-Market & Documentation:</strong> Own all customer-facing communications and technical documentation, ensuring complex security features are easily understood and adopted by our users.</li> <li><strong>Cross-Functional Leadership:</strong> Serve as the primary point of contact for your products, both internally and externally.</li> <li><strong>Sales & Support Enablement:</strong> Actively support the sales organization across all stages of customer engagement (pre-sales strategy and post-sales expansion and adoption). We ensure that all of the new and existing features and functionality that Cloudflare offers can be managed at scale and meet the needs of our massively growing, global customer base.</p> <p><strong>About the role</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Software Engineer in the Deploy@Scale team, you will provide technical leadership for the platform that powers safe, reliable, and automated deployments across Cloudflare. This is a senior IC role: you will set technical direction across multiple work streams, not just execute within one. </p> <p>You'll be expected to operate with significant autonomy - identifying the right problems to solve, driving architecture decisions that will hold up over multiple years, and influencing how dozens of engineering teams across Cloudflare think about safe change. You will partner directly with your EM and leadership to shape the multi-quarter roadmap, and you'll be a primary technical voice in cross-team design reviews, RFCs, and incident retrospectives that touch deployment safety.</p> <p>You'll spend meaningful time unblocking and elevating the rest of the team: reviewing designs before they become code, pairing on the hardest problems, and raising the technical bar through mentorship - without needing to be a people manager to do it. You will thrive in a fast-paced iterative engineering environment with short release cycles.</p> <p>This role may require flexibility to be on-call outside of standard working hours to address technical issues as needed.</p> <p><strong>Examples of desirable skills, knowledge, and experience</strong></p> <ul> <li>8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience, including a track record of owning the architecture of complex, distributed, production-critical systems end to end.</li> <li>Demonstrated technical leadership beyond your own code: driving RFCs and design reviews that other senior engineers and teams rely on, and being sought out as a technical escalation point.</li> <li>Judgment for ambiguity — comfortable defining the problem and the roadmap, not just the solution, in an environment where requirements are not fully specified upfront.</li> <li>Deep experience with safety, observability, and automation in production systems: designing rollback paths, health signals, and guardrails that other systems and teams build on top of.</li> <li>Experience influencing technical direction across team boundaries — through architecture, mentorship, or platform APIs/contracts — without direct authority.</li> <li>Comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with AI as a working tool: fluent use of AI-assisted development, critical evaluation of its output, and a point of view on where it should and shouldn't be trusted in a safety-critical system.</li> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration, long-running/durable execution, or large-scale distributed systems is a strong plus.</li> <li>Strong written and verbal communication — this role requires writing docs and RFCs that persuade and align, not just describe.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Bonus points</strong></p> <ul> <li>Prior experience owning a deployment, progressive delivery, or change-management platform at scale.</li> <li>Experience leading a technical migration across many independent teams (e.g., a platform sunset/replacement).</li> </ul> <h4><strong data-path-to-node="3" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <p data-path-to-node="4">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p data-path-to-node="4">Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p data-path-to-node="4"><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term title: Senior Software Engineer, PKI & Cryptographic Systems
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p>At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><h3>Available Locations: Austin, London, or Lisbon (Hybrid)</h3> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-Abouttherole">About the role</h3> <p>TLS is the connective tissue of the Internet, and Cloudflare terminates a large fraction of it. Every day our network handles tens of millions of certificate operations across products like Universal SSL, SSL for SaaS, Origin CA, Cloudflare Access, and Cloudflare Tunnel — and the WebPKI ecosystem underneath all of it is undergoing its largest structural change in a generation: shorter certificate lifetimes, a shift toward post-quantum-safe signature algorithms, and new automation and trust-establishment mechanisms on the horizon.</p> <p>We are investing in the next generation of Cloudflare’s PKI and cryptographic infrastructure to keep up with, and stay ahead of, that shift. As a Senior Software Engineer on this team, you will design and build the systems that manage certificate lifecycles, protect and use private keys at scale, integrate with hardware security modules, automate issuance and renewal, and take Cloudflare’s cryptographic stack into the post-quantum era. You will work at the intersection of applied cryptography, distributed systems, and security engineering — on infrastructure that a large fraction of the Internet quietly depends on.</p> <p>This is an early-days role on a growing team. The design decisions you make in the first year will shape how Cloudflare’s certificate and key infrastructure operates for years to come.</p> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-Responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li><strong>Design and build core PKI systems</strong> — certificate lifecycle management, X.509 issuance and validation logic, key parameter enforcement, and policy engines aligned with industry standards including CA/Browser Forum guidance and browser root program policies.</li> <li><strong>Own the cryptographic core.</strong> Integrate with FIPS 140-2 Level 3 (and, where required, Level 4) HSMs via PKCS#11 and vendor-native SDKs; build key ceremony and key-lifecycle tooling; enforce strict key-usage boundaries in code.</li> <li><strong>Automate at scale.</strong> Build and evolve ACME-based issuance and renewal pipelines, short-lived certificate rotation, and revocation mechanisms that serve at Cloudflare’s global scale.</li> <li><strong>Instrument transparency and audit trails.</strong> Integrate with Certificate Transparency, build append-only tamper-evident logging, and design evidence pipelines that hold up to rigorous third-party audit.</li> <li><strong>Maintain accreditation and respond to a changing compliance landscape.</strong> PKI operations must maintain compliance under CA/B Forum, WebTrust, and root store program frameworks. You will be aware of, and adapt to, changes in relevant policies, participate in public incident disclosure and discourse, and participate in regular third-party audits.</li> <li><strong>Represent Cloudflare in the WebPKI community.</strong> Write public CA incident reports and serve as a primary contact with the WebPKI community; clear technical writing is core to this role.</li> <li><strong>Ship the post-quantum future.</strong> Contribute to Cloudflare’s ongoing post-quantum migration — including work on post-quantum encryption and authentication — so that Cloudflare’s cryptographic infrastructure stays ahead of the transition.</li> <li><strong>Own code end-to-end</strong> from design through production incident response. Cryptographic infrastructure cannot silently fail; you will build the observability, runbooks, and on-call posture that keep the service inside SLO.</li> <li><strong>Partner across the org</strong> — with the SSL/TLS product teams, the HSM and data-centre infrastructure teams, the Cloudflare Research applied cryptography group, and adjacent product teams that consume PKI as a platform.</li> <li><strong>Raise the bar.</strong> Mentor other engineers joining an early-stage team, run design reviews, and establish the engineering standards, threat models, and secure-development practices this team will operate under for years.</li> </ul> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-DesirableSkills,Knowledge&Experience">Desirable Skills, Knowledge & Experience</h3> <ul> <li><strong>5+ years of production systems software experience,</strong> with a strong operational track record — you have carried a pager for something people depend on.</li> <li><strong>Deep working knowledge of applied cryptography and PKI.</strong> X.509, ASN.1/DER, RFC 5280, CRL distribution, Certificate Transparency, ACME, and the CA/Browser Forum Baseline Requirements. You do not need to be a cryptographer, but you need to reason precisely about certificate profiles, key parameters, and issuance policy.</li> <li><strong>Familiarity with HSMs.</strong> PKCS#11 integration, key ceremonies, key-attestation flows, and understanding of what FIPS 140-2/3 validation actually means in production.</li> <li><strong>Strong systems programming background</strong> in at least one of Go, Rust, or C/C++.</li> <li><strong>Distributed systems fluency</strong> — you have built or operated globally replicated, availability-critical services with strict correctness guarantees.</li> <li><strong>Experience designing and operating database schemas for high-integrity systems</strong> (Postgres or equivalent).</li> <li><strong>Security-hardened system design instincts</strong> — threat modelling, defence in depth, least privilege, and secure key handling.</li> <li><strong>Comfort with high-consequence work.</strong> A mis-issued or mis-revoked certificate is a public, industry-visible event. You need the temperament to move quickly and the discipline to be careful.</li> </ul> <h3 id="JD—SeniorSoftwareEngineer,PKI&CryptographicSystems(MergedDraft)-BonusPoints">Bonus Points</h3> <ul> <li>Direct experience working on or with a publicly-trusted or private CA, or a large-scale internal PKI (Let’s Encrypt / Boulder, Google Trust Services, DigiCert, Sectigo, ISRG, Entrust, Microsoft PKI, HashiCorp Vault PKI, step-ca, CFSSL, or an internal CA at scale).</li> <li>Experience with <code>crypto/x509</code>, BoringSSL, OpenSSL/AWS-LC, CFSSL, or an equivalent PKI codebase.</li> <li>Experience with WebTrust for CAs / WebTrust BR / WebTrust Network Security audit engagements.</li> <li>Familiarity with post-quantum cryptography — ML-DSA, ML-KEM, hybrid signature schemes, and the current state of PQ signature standardisation.</li> <li>Familiarity with emerging browser trust-establishment proposals (e.g. Merkle Tree Certificates).</li> <li>Prior participation in the CA/Browser Forum, IETF LAMPS / TLS / PLANTS / PQUIP working groups, the transparency.dev community, or a browser root program review.</li> <li>Experience running or automating offline key ceremonies.</li> <li>Experience operating Certificate Transparency log infrastructure or CT monitoring at scale.</li> <li>Familiarity with formal methods, differential fuzzing, or property-based testing for cryptographic protocol code.</li> <li>Kubernetes experience.</li> </ul> <h4 data-path-to-node="0"><strong data-path-to-node="0" data-index-in-node="0">Compensation</strong></h4> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €83,000.</p> </li> </ul> <h4 data-path-to-node="2"><strong data-path-to-node="2" data-index-in-node="0">Equity</strong></h4> <ul data-path-to-node="3"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="3,0,0">This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul> <p> </p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re

Cloudflare.</li> <li>Published reusable reference architectures and field guidance that elevate the entire team.</li> <li>Improved the field organization’s ability to position, architect, and deliver Cloudflare’s developer and AI solutions.</li> <li>Cultivated the technical leadership of your colleagues through active mentorship and enablement.</li> <li>Provided product teams with consistent, evidence-based insights into regional customer requirements and adoption barriers.</li> <li>Become recognized as a supportive, authoritative Developer Platform leader across APJC.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Meaningful Experience:</strong> A strong background in solutions architecture, software engineering, technical consulting, or a related customer-facing technical role. A significant portion of your portfolio will consist of clients based in India.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Collaboration:</strong> A track record of owning complex technical strategies involving developers, infrastructure teams, security stakeholders, and senior executives.</li> <li><strong>Technical Depth:</strong> Deep working knowledge of distributed application architecture (compute, storage, networking, security, reliability, and observability).</li> <li><strong>Hands-On Capability:</strong> Software-development experience, including the ability to build or review production-quality applications and proofs of concept (preferably in JavaScript or TypeScript).</li> <li><strong>Ecosystem Knowledge:</strong> A strong understanding of modern web technologies, serverless/cloud-native architectures, modern software-delivery practices, and at least one major public cloud platform.</li> <li><strong>Influential Leadership:</strong> A proven ability to influence without direct authority, thoughtfully mentor colleagues, and turn individual solutions into shared organizational capabilities.</li> <li><strong>Communication:</strong> Excellent written, presentation, and facilitation skills tailored for developer, architectural, and executive audiences.</li> <li><strong>Travel:</strong> Ability to travel up to 30%, primarily within APJC, including India (supported by flexible planning).</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Nice-to-Have (Bonus Skills)</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Experience building and operating production applications on Cloudflare’s Developer degree in computer science, engineering, or a related discipline, OR equivalent practical experience.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Important Note: </strong><em>At Cloudflare, we know that great candidates executive audiences, with the ability to connect technical capabilities to risk reduction, operational improvement, and business outcomes.</li> <li>Ability to collaborate across Sales, Product, capabilities such as Access, Gateway, Cloudflare One Client, Browser Isolation, CASB, DLP, Email Security, Cloudflare Tunnel, or Cloudflare WAN.</li> <li>Experience displacing, integrating, or Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. The IAM team owns the authentication and authorization systems behind that: the identity layer of the Control Plane operating at global scale. Our surface spans things like login and SSO, OAuth and API tokens, account membership, roles and permissions, and SCIM provisioning.</p> <p>We're hiring a hands-on senior engineer to work on correctness-critical, high-throughput, highly resilient services. You'll own surfaces end-to-end, chase down hard problems with high agency, and improve systems while they're serving production traffic.</p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Feature development</strong>: design and build high-throughput, low-latency IAM capabilities that power both customer-facing and internal service APIs.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>System evolution</strong>: contribute to the design and evolution of our authentication and authorization systems into modern, distributed, and edge-capable architectures.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>API and system design</strong>: translate product and security requirements into robust, well-structured APIs and technical specifications in collaboration with Product, Security, and UX teams.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Engineering excellence</strong>: maintain a high bar through thorough code reviews, technical design documents, and collaborative problem-solving.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Operational stewardship</strong>: own the reliability of the platform under constant load, ensuring observability and resilience are built into every service.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>AI-assisted development</strong>: use AI tools throughout your workflow, from code generation to debugging, and bring the judgment to know when to trust them.</p> </li> </ul> <h3><strong>Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience</strong></h3> <p>These are examples of what a strong candidate brings:</p> <ul> <li> <p><strong>Professional Experience: </strong>5-8 years building and operating production systems at scale.</p> </li> <li> <p><strong>Identity Domain Knowledge: </strong>Working knowledge of identity protocols and models (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, SCIM, RBAC/ABAC, and session management, etc.). Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.</p> <p>At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.</p></div><p><strong>Location:</strong> London, Lisbon, or Austin - (Hybrid)</p> <p>Join the team helping shape the future of the Internet. We’re building high-performance systems that handle a <em>quarter of the Internet’s traffic</em>. Our work influences open standards (like QUIC, MASQUE, and ECH), involves close collaboration with the IETF, and pushes the boundaries of what's possible in networking and security.</p> <p>You don’t need to be an HTTP or cryptography expert to join — we’re looking for excellent engineers who love tough problems, want to learn deeply, and are excited to contribute to one of the most technically demanding areas of infrastructure.</p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and operate systems that terminate HTTP and TLS at Internet scale</li> <li>Migrate core infrastructure from NGINX to a next-gen Rust-based proxy</li> <li>Measure and improve protocol performance across real-world traffic</li> <li>Contribute to open source and industry standards</li> <li>Learn from and work alongside some of the leading engineers in this space<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>You might be a good fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Have solid systems programming experience (Rust, C, or similar)</li> <li>Thrive in complex technical domains and enjoy learning new things</li> <li>Care about building reliable, secure, and performant software</li> <li>Are motivated by impact — technical, operational, and on the Internet itself</li> <li>Come from a background that’s underrepresented in tech — we value diverse perspectives<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Perks include:</strong><strong><br></strong>Flexible work hours • Take-what-you-need vacation • RSUs • ESPP • Meaningful technical challenges every day</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong></p> <p>Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.</p> <ul data-path-to-node="1"> <li> <p data-path-to-node="1,0,0">For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €54,000 - €75,000.</p> </li> </ul> <p><strong>Equity</strong></p> <p>This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.</p> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <p>Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.</p> <p><strong>Health & Welfare Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical/Rx Insurance</li> <li>Dental Insurance</li> <li>Vision Insurance</li> <li>Flexible Spending Accounts</li> <li>Commuter Spending Accounts</li> <li>Fertility & Family Forming Benefits</li> <li>On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program</li> <li>Global Travel Medical Insurance</li> </ul> <p><strong>Financial Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Short and Long Term Disability Insurance</li> <li>Life & Accident Insurance</li> <li>401(k) Retirement Savings Plan</li> <li>Employee Stock Participation Plan</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave</li> <li>Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>What Makes Cloudflare Special?</h3> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.</span></p> <p><a href="https://blog.cloudflare.com/protecting-free-expression-online/"><strong>Project Galileo</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.</span></p> <p><strong><a href="https://www.cloudflare.com/athenian/">Athenian Project</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.</span></p> <p><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"><strong>1.1.1.1</strong></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">: We released</span><a href="https://1.1.1.1/"> <span style="font-weight: 400;">1.1.1.1</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our</span><a href="https://developers.cloudflare.com/1.1.1.1/privacy/public-dns-resolver"> privacy commitment</a><span style="font-weight: 400;"> and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual</span> <span style="font-weight: 400;">race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">hr@cloudflare.com</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.</span></p></div>

requests for customer information.</li> <li>Deep technical experience understanding how the Internet works. </li> <li>Understanding of the Internet ecosystem and the roles and functions of the various high level. </li> <li>A global network of contacts --you can reach the right people quickly to help solve problems that you can’t solve directly. </li> <li>Experience working on international issues
